StoreFileProfile.cs (StoreTrainer 2.0 — Backward-Compatible .stf Profile Model)

[StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern)]

Modern C# game and trainer profile model preserving 100% file compatibility with classic 1.0 and 1.1 .stf profiles.

// ================================================================================
// FILE: StoreFileProfile.cs
// PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0 (StoreTrainer.csproj)
// LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation & Creative Content)
//
// PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
//   What is a StoreFile ('.stf'), and what does this class represent?
//     In RaggieSoft StoreTrainer, every game + trainer pairing is saved in your
//     'Documents\My StoreFiles' folder as a plain-text '.stf' file structured in
//     classic Windows INI sections ('[General]', '[Game]', and '[Trainer]').
//
//     Here is what an actual '.stf' file looks like on disk:
//       [General]
//       STF.Version=1.1
//       DisplayName=Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2
//       Category=Strategy
//       Favorite=true
//       LaunchDelay=3
//       WaitForGameReady=true
//       Notes=Press F1 on the main menu to enable unlimited credits.
//
//       [Game]
//       LaunchGameFirst=true
//       Path=C:\Games\RA2\ra2.exe
//       Switch=-win
//       WorkingDirectory=
//
//       [Trainer]
//       TrainerLaunchesGame=false
//       Path=C:\Games\Trainers\ra2_plus5.exe
//       Switch=
//       WorkingDirectory=
//       Fingerprint=A1B2C3...
//
//   How does StoreTrainer 2.0 stay 100% backward-compatible with VB6 v1.0 & v1.1?
//     - Classic StoreTrainer v1.0 & v1.1 read '[General] STF.Version', '[Game]
//       LaunchGameFirst / Path / Switch', and '[Trainer] TrainerLaunchesGame /
//       Path / Switch' (plus 'LaunchDelay' in v1.1), ignoring any extra INI keys!
//     - StoreTrainer 2.0 writes 'STF.Version=1.1' and keeps every single classic
//       section and key name identical, so you can share the exact same 'My StoreFiles'
//       folder across a Windows 98 / Windows 2000 retro PC running VB6 v1.1 and a
//       modern PC running StoreTrainer 2.0!
// ================================================================================

using System.IO; // 'Path.GetFileName' and 'Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension'.

namespace StoreTrainer.Models;

/// <summary>
/// Represents a single saved (or unsaved draft) game-and-trainer profile (<c>.stf</c>).
/// </summary>
public sealed class StoreFileProfile
{
    // Full path on disk (e.g., 'C:\Users\You\Documents\My StoreFiles\RedAlert2.stf'),
    // or empty string '""' when creating a brand-new unsaved profile.
    public string FilePath { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    // File format version written to '[General] STF.Version'. Kept at '1.1' so classic
    // VB6 StoreTrainer v1.1 can also open profiles saved by StoreTrainer 2.0!
    public string FormatVersion { get; set; } = "1.1";

    // Friendly title shown in the StoreTrainer 2.0 sidebar list (falls back to filename if blank).
    public string DisplayName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    // Optional organizer tag ('Action', 'RPG', 'Strategy', 'Retro PC', 'Simulation', etc.).
    public string Category { get; set; } = "General";

    // Pins favorite games to the top of the library list when starred.
    public bool IsFavorite { get; set; }

    // --- Launch Order & Timing Controls ---
    // True when the trainer itself starts the game executable (disables separate game launch).
    public bool TrainerLaunchesGame { get; set; }

    // True when the game must open BEFORE the trainer attaches to it.
    public bool LaunchGameFirst { get; set; }

    // Modern 2.0 enhancement: waits until the first program's main window finishes loading
    // ('Process.WaitForInputIdle') before counting down 'LaunchDelaySeconds'.
    public bool WaitForGameReady { get; set; } = true;

    // Optional pause (0 to 30 seconds) between starting the first and second program.
    public int LaunchDelaySeconds { get; set; }

    // Free-form hotkey reminders (e.g., "Numpad 1 = Infinite Health, Numpad 2 = Ammo").
    public string Notes { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    // --- Game Program Settings ---
    public string GamePath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string GameSwitch { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    // Optional custom folder override; if blank, defaults to the folder containing GamePath.
    public string GameWorkingDirectory { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    // --- Companion Trainer Program Settings ---
    public string TrainerPath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string TrainerSwitch { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    // Optional custom folder override; if blank, defaults to the folder containing TrainerPath.
    public string TrainerWorkingDirectory { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    // Optional file-verification fingerprint so StoreTrainer warns if a trainer file on disk
    // was unexpectedly modified or replaced since the user pinned it.
    public bool VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch { get; set; }
    public string TrainerFingerprint { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    // --- Computed Read-Only Properties Bound Directly by MainWindow.xaml ---

    // True if this profile has never been saved to a '.stf' file on disk yet.
    public bool IsUnsavedNew => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FilePath);

    // Friendly card title shown in the left library list.
    public string DisplayTitle
    {
        get
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DisplayName))
            {
                return DisplayName.Trim();
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FilePath))
            {
                return Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(FilePath);
            }

            return "Untitled Game Profile";
        }
    }

    // Compact filename pill shown on each sidebar card (e.g., 'redalert2.stf').
    public string FileNameBadge =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FilePath) ? "unsaved draft" : Path.GetFileName(FilePath);

    // One-line summary shown beneath the title in the left library list.
    public string SubtitleSummary
    {
        get
        {
            var star = IsFavorite ? "★ Favorite • " : string.Empty;
            var cat = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Category) ? "General" : Category.Trim();
            var mode = TrainerLaunchesGame
                ? "Trainer Starts Game"
                : LaunchGameFirst
                    ? "Game First → Trainer"
                    : "Game + Trainer";
            return $"{star}{cat} • {mode}";
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates an independent deep copy of this profile (used for Duplicate Profile and change tracking).
    /// </summary>
    public StoreFileProfile Clone() => new()
    {
        FilePath = FilePath,
        FormatVersion = FormatVersion,
        DisplayName = DisplayName,
        Category = Category,
        IsFavorite = IsFavorite,
        TrainerLaunchesGame = TrainerLaunchesGame,
        LaunchGameFirst = LaunchGameFirst,
        WaitForGameReady = WaitForGameReady,
        LaunchDelaySeconds = LaunchDelaySeconds,
        Notes = Notes,
        GamePath = GamePath,
        GameSwitch = GameSwitch,
        GameWorkingDirectory = GameWorkingDirectory,
        TrainerPath = TrainerPath,
        TrainerSwitch = TrainerSwitch,
        TrainerWorkingDirectory = TrainerWorkingDirectory,
        VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch = VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch,
        TrainerFingerprint = TrainerFingerprint
    };
}

StoreTrainerService.cs (StoreTrainer 2.0 — Library Scanner, Sequencer & File Verification)

[StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern)]

Zero-dependency INI reader/writer, My StoreFiles library scanner, window-ready launch sequencer, and trusted trainer file verification.

// ================================================================================
// FILE: StoreTrainerService.cs
// PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0 (StoreTrainer.csproj)
// LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation & Creative Content)
//
// PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
//   What is this file?
//     Think of StoreTrainerService.cs as the back-end engine behind StoreTrainer 2.0.
//     While MainWindow.xaml draws buttons and text boxes, this service handles all
//     disk files, folder discovery, file verification, and program launching:
//       1. Classic 'TStore.ini' & 'My StoreFiles' Compatibility:
//          Reads and updates '%APPDATA%\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini' — the
//          exact same configuration file created by classic VB6 StoreTrainer 1.0 & 1.1!
//          That means when an existing StoreTrainer 1.0/1.1 user upgrades to 2.0,
//          StoreTrainer 2.0 immediately finds their custom 'My StoreFiles' folder
//          with zero manual re-importing.
//       2. Zero-Dependency INI Parser & Writer:
//          Reads and writes classic '[Section] Key=Value' '.stf' files cleanly in
//          UTF-8/ANSI-compatible plain text, preserving any third-party or future keys.
//       3. Smart Game & Trainer Launch Sequencer ('LaunchProfileAsync'):
//          Fixes every classic working-directory quirk by setting each launched
//          program's working folder to its own parent folder (or the user's custom
//          working folder), optionally waiting for the first window to finish
//          opening ('WaitForInputIdle'), pausing for 'LaunchDelaySeconds', and
//          starting the companion program cleanly.
//       4. Optional Trainer File Verification ('ComputeFileFingerprint'):
//          Computes a cryptographic SHA-256 fingerprint of a trainer '.exe' when
//          pinned by the user, warning before launch if the file on disk ever
//          changes unexpectedly.
// ================================================================================

using System.Diagnostics;           // 'Process' and 'ProcessStartInfo' for starting games & trainers.
using System.IO;                    // 'File', 'Directory', and 'Path' operations.
using System.Security.Cryptography; // 'SHA256' for trainer file verification fingerprints.
using System.Text;                  // 'Encoding' and 'StringBuilder'.
using StoreTrainer.Models;          // 'StoreFileProfile' data model.

namespace StoreTrainer.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Result record returned when loading a <c>.stf</c> profile from disk.
/// </summary>
public sealed record StoreFileLoadResult(bool Success, StoreFileProfile? Profile, string ErrorMessage);

/// <summary>
/// Result record returned when launching a game and trainer profile.
/// </summary>
public sealed record StoreTrainerLaunchResult(bool Success, int ErrorCode, string Message);

/// <summary>
/// Manages StoreTrainer configuration (<c>TStore.ini</c>), <c>.stf</c> profile files,
/// trainer file fingerprints, and sequenced game/trainer process launching.
/// </summary>
public sealed class StoreTrainerService
{
    // Highest '.stf' format version understood by StoreTrainer 2.0 ('1.0' and '1.1' both load cleanly).
    public const string CurrentSupportedStfVersion = "1.1";

    /// <summary>
    /// Path to classic StoreTrainer roaming settings directory (<c>%APPDATA%\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer</c>).
    /// </summary>
    public string ClassicAppDataDirectory =>
        Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.ApplicationData), "RaggieSoft", "StoreTrainer");

    /// <summary>
    /// Path to classic <c>TStore.ini</c> inside <c>%APPDATA%\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini</c>.
    /// </summary>
    public string ClassicIniFilePath => Path.Combine(ClassicAppDataDirectory, "TStore.ini");

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves (and creates if missing) the user's active <c>My StoreFiles</c> library folder,
    /// honoring any existing custom folder saved in <c>TStore.ini</c> by StoreTrainer 1.0 or 1.1.
    /// </summary>
    public string EnsureLibraryFolder()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(ClassicAppDataDirectory);

        var iniData = File.Exists(ClassicIniFilePath)
            ? ReadIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath)
            : new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        var configuredFolder = GetIniValue(iniData, "Library", "Folder", string.Empty);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredFolder) ||
            string.Equals(configuredFolder, "NO_FOLDER_CREATED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            var documents = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyDocuments);
            configuredFolder = Path.Combine(documents, "My StoreFiles");
        }

        Directory.CreateDirectory(configuredFolder);

        // Keep classic TStore.ini up to date so VB6 v1.1 and v2.0 stay synchronized if both are used.
        SetIniValue(iniData, "General", "Version", "2.0.0");
        SetIniValue(iniData, "General", "Path", AppContext.BaseDirectory.TrimEnd('\\', '/'));
        SetIniValue(iniData, "Library", "Folder", configuredFolder);
        WriteIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath, iniData);

        return configuredFolder;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Updates the active StoreFiles library directory in <c>TStore.ini</c>.
    /// </summary>
    public void SetLibraryFolder(string newFolderPath)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newFolderPath))
        {
            return;
        }

        Directory.CreateDirectory(newFolderPath);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(ClassicAppDataDirectory);

        var iniData = File.Exists(ClassicIniFilePath)
            ? ReadIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath)
            : new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        SetIniValue(iniData, "Library", "Folder", newFolderPath);
        WriteIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath, iniData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Reads or saves the user's preferred color theme (<c>System</c>, <c>Dark</c>, or <c>Light</c>)
    /// inside <c>TStore.ini</c> under <c>[Appearance] Theme</c>.
    /// </summary>
    public string GetSavedThemePreference()
    {
        if (!File.Exists(ClassicIniFilePath))
        {
            return "System";
        }

        var iniData = ReadIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath);
        return GetIniValue(iniData, "Appearance", "Theme", "System");
    }

    public void SaveThemePreference(string theme)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(ClassicAppDataDirectory);
        var iniData = File.Exists(ClassicIniFilePath)
            ? ReadIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath)
            : new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        SetIniValue(iniData, "Appearance", "Theme", theme);
        WriteIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath, iniData);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Scans the user's library folder for all <c>*.stf</c> profiles, sorted with Favorites first
    /// and then alphabetically by <see cref="StoreFileProfile.DisplayTitle"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public List<StoreFileProfile> LoadLibraryProfiles(string libraryFolder)
    {
        var list = new List<StoreFileProfile>();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(libraryFolder) || !Directory.Exists(libraryFolder))
        {
            return list;
        }

        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(libraryFolder, "*.stf", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
        {
            var res = LoadStoreFile(file);
            if (res.Success && res.Profile is not null)
            {
                list.Add(res.Profile);
            }
        }

        // OrderByDescending(p => p.IsFavorite) puts 'true' (starred favorites) above 'false',
        // and ThenBy(..., OrdinalIgnoreCase) sorts alphabetically within each group!
        return list
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.IsFavorite)
            .ThenBy(p => p.DisplayTitle, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Loads a single <c>.stf</c> INI profile from disk, validating compatibility with
    /// classic <c>1.0</c>, <c>1.1</c>, and <c>2.0</c> profile keys.
    /// </summary>
    public StoreFileLoadResult LoadStoreFile(string filePath)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filePath) || !File.Exists(filePath))
        {
            return new StoreFileLoadResult(false, null, $"The StoreFile could not be found:\n{filePath}");
        }

        try
        {
            var sections = ReadIniSections(filePath);
            var stfVer = GetIniValue(sections, "General", "STF.Version", "1.0");

            // Reject only if a future major version (e.g. 3.0) is encountered; accept both 1.0 and 1.1!
            if (CompareDottedVersions(stfVer, "2.0") > 0)
            {
                return new StoreFileLoadResult(
                    false,
                    null,
                    $"This StoreFile requires a newer version of RaggieSoft StoreTrainer (file format {stfVer}).");
            }

            var delayRaw = GetIniValue(sections, "General", "LaunchDelay", "0");
            _ = int.TryParse(delayRaw, out var delaySec);
            delaySec = Math.Clamp(delaySec, 0, 30);

            var trainerFingerprint = GetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "Fingerprint", string.Empty);
            var verifyRaw = GetIniValue(
                sections,
                "Trainer",
                "VerifyBeforeLaunch",
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(trainerFingerprint) ? "true" : "false");

            var trainerLaunchesGame = ParseIniBool(GetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "TrainerLaunchesGame", "false"));
            var launchGameFirst = !trainerLaunchesGame &&
                                  ParseIniBool(GetIniValue(sections, "Game", "LaunchGameFirst", "false"));

            // Unescape '\n' tokens back into real multi-line notes for the editor TextBox.
            var rawNotes = GetIniValue(sections, "General", "Notes", string.Empty)
                .Replace("\\n", Environment.NewLine, StringComparison.Ordinal);

            var profile = new StoreFileProfile
            {
                FilePath = filePath,
                FormatVersion = "1.1",
                DisplayName = GetIniValue(sections, "General", "DisplayName", string.Empty),
                Category = GetIniValue(sections, "General", "Category", "General"),
                IsFavorite = ParseIniBool(GetIniValue(sections, "General", "Favorite", "false")),
                LaunchDelaySeconds = delaySec,
                WaitForGameReady = ParseIniBool(GetIniValue(sections, "General", "WaitForGameReady", "true")),
                Notes = rawNotes,
                TrainerLaunchesGame = trainerLaunchesGame,
                LaunchGameFirst = launchGameFirst,
                GamePath = GetIniValue(sections, "Game", "Path", string.Empty),
                GameSwitch = GetIniValue(sections, "Game", "Switch", string.Empty),
                GameWorkingDirectory = GetIniValue(sections, "Game", "WorkingDirectory", string.Empty),
                TrainerPath = GetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "Path", string.Empty),
                TrainerSwitch = GetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "Switch", string.Empty),
                TrainerWorkingDirectory = GetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "WorkingDirectory", string.Empty),
                TrainerFingerprint = trainerFingerprint,
                VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch = ParseIniBool(verifyRaw)
            };

            RecordRecentStoreFile(filePath);
            return new StoreFileLoadResult(true, profile, string.Empty);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return new StoreFileLoadResult(false, null, $"Could not read StoreFile:\n{ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Writes a <see cref="StoreFileProfile"/> to disk in backward-compatible <c>.stf</c> INI format.
    /// </summary>
    public void SaveStoreFile(StoreFileProfile profile, string targetFilePath)
    {
        var dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(targetFilePath);
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dir))
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
        }

        // Enforce mutual exclusivity (if the trainer launches the game, 'LaunchGameFirst' must be false).
        if (profile.TrainerLaunchesGame)
        {
            profile.LaunchGameFirst = false;
        }

        var sections = File.Exists(targetFilePath)
            ? ReadIniSections(targetFilePath)
            : new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        // Write '1.1' so classic VB6 StoreTrainer v1.1 can open this exact '.stf' file too!
        SetIniValue(sections, "General", "STF.Version", CurrentSupportedStfVersion);
        SetIniValue(sections, "General", "DisplayName", profile.DisplayName.Trim());
        SetIniValue(sections, "General", "Category", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.Category) ? "General" : profile.Category.Trim());
        SetIniValue(sections, "General", "Favorite", profile.IsFavorite ? "true" : "false");
        SetIniValue(sections, "General", "LaunchDelay", Math.Clamp(profile.LaunchDelaySeconds, 0, 30).ToString());
        SetIniValue(sections, "General", "WaitForGameReady", profile.WaitForGameReady ? "true" : "false");

        // Collapse multi-line notes onto a single INI line using '\n' escape tokens so classic
        // Win32 GetPrivateProfileStringA never trips over embedded line breaks.
        var singleLineNotes = (profile.Notes ?? string.Empty)
            .Replace("\r\n", "\\n", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            .Replace("\n", "\\n", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            .Replace("\r", "\\n", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        SetIniValue(sections, "General", "Notes", singleLineNotes);

        SetIniValue(sections, "Game", "LaunchGameFirst", profile.LaunchGameFirst ? "true" : "false");
        SetIniValue(sections, "Game", "Path", profile.GamePath.Trim());
        SetIniValue(sections, "Game", "Switch", profile.GameSwitch.Trim());
        SetIniValue(sections, "Game", "WorkingDirectory", profile.GameWorkingDirectory.Trim());

        SetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "TrainerLaunchesGame", profile.TrainerLaunchesGame ? "true" : "false");
        SetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "Path", profile.TrainerPath.Trim());
        SetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "Switch", profile.TrainerSwitch.Trim());
        SetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "WorkingDirectory", profile.TrainerWorkingDirectory.Trim());
        SetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "VerifyBeforeLaunch", profile.VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch ? "true" : "false");
        SetIniValue(sections, "Trainer", "Fingerprint", profile.TrainerFingerprint.Trim());

        WriteIniSections(targetFilePath, sections);
        profile.FilePath = targetFilePath;
        RecordRecentStoreFile(targetFilePath);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Computes an uppercase hexadecimal fingerprint of a trainer file on disk so
    /// StoreTrainer can alert the user if the file is ever altered unexpectedly.
    /// </summary>
    public string ComputeFileFingerprint(string executablePath)
    {
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(executablePath);
        var hashBytes = SHA256.HashData(stream);
        return Convert.ToHexString(hashBytes);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Validates paths and optional trainer fingerprint, then launches the game and/or
    /// companion trainer in the user's configured sequence with proper working directories.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<StoreTrainerLaunchResult> LaunchProfileAsync(
        StoreFileProfile profile,
        Func<string, bool>? confirmFingerprintMismatch = null)
    {
        // 1. Verify Trainer exists if provided (required unless user saved a game-only profile,
        //    though classic StoreTrainer always pairs a trainer — we allow optional blank trainer
        //    ONLY when TrainerLaunchesGame is false AND GamePath exists, giving 2.0 users bonus
        //    flexibility to also launch standalone games with custom launch options!).
        var hasTrainer = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.TrainerPath);
        var hasGame = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.GamePath);

        if (profile.TrainerLaunchesGame && !hasTrainer)
        {
            return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(
                false,
                2,
                "\"Trainer Launches Game\" is checked, so please choose a trainer program file first.");
        }

        if (!hasTrainer && !hasGame)
        {
            return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(
                false,
                2,
                "Please choose a game file (and optional trainer file) before launching.");
        }

        if (hasTrainer && !File.Exists(profile.TrainerPath))
        {
            return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(
                false,
                2,
                $"The trainer file could not be found at:\n{profile.TrainerPath}");
        }

        if (!profile.TrainerLaunchesGame && hasGame && !File.Exists(profile.GamePath))
        {
            return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(
                false,
                3,
                $"The game file could not be found at:\n{profile.GamePath}");
        }

        if (!profile.TrainerLaunchesGame && !hasGame)
        {
            return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(
                false,
                3,
                "Please choose the game program file, or check \"Trainer Launches Game\" if your trainer starts the game automatically.");
        }

        // 2. Optional Trainer File Verification Check
        if (hasTrainer && profile.VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.TrainerFingerprint))
        {
            var currentFingerprint = ComputeFileFingerprint(profile.TrainerPath);
            if (!string.Equals(currentFingerprint, profile.TrainerFingerprint.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                var prompt =
                    $"The trainer file on disk has changed since you pinned its safety verification:\n\n" +
                    $"{profile.TrainerPath}\n\n" +
                    "Do you still want to launch this trainer?";
                var proceed = confirmFingerprintMismatch?.Invoke(prompt) ?? false;
                if (!proceed)
                {
                    return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(false, 4, "Launch canceled because the trainer file changed.");
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Execute launch sequence
        try
        {
            var delayMs = Math.Clamp(profile.LaunchDelaySeconds, 0, 30) * 1000;

            // Mode A: Trainer launches the game by itself -> start Trainer only!
            if (profile.TrainerLaunchesGame)
            {
                StartProgram(profile.TrainerPath, profile.TrainerSwitch, profile.TrainerWorkingDirectory, waitForReady: false);
                return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(true, 0, $"Launched trainer for {profile.DisplayTitle}");
            }

            // Mode B: Game only (no trainer path entered) -> start Game with its switches!
            if (!hasTrainer)
            {
                StartProgram(profile.GamePath, profile.GameSwitch, profile.GameWorkingDirectory, waitForReady: false);
                return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(true, 0, $"Launched {profile.DisplayTitle}");
            }

            // Mode C: Launch Game First -> wait for game window / delay -> launch Trainer
            if (profile.LaunchGameFirst)
            {
                StartProgram(profile.GamePath, profile.GameSwitch, profile.GameWorkingDirectory, waitForReady: profile.WaitForGameReady);
                if (delayMs > 0)
                {
                    await Task.Delay(delayMs);
                }
                StartProgram(profile.TrainerPath, profile.TrainerSwitch, profile.TrainerWorkingDirectory, waitForReady: false);
                return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(true, 0, $"Launched {profile.DisplayTitle} (game first, then trainer)");
            }

            // Mode D: Default simultaneous / Trainer-then-Game launch
            StartProgram(profile.TrainerPath, profile.TrainerSwitch, profile.TrainerWorkingDirectory, waitForReady: profile.WaitForGameReady);
            if (delayMs > 0)
            {
                await Task.Delay(delayMs);
            }
            StartProgram(profile.GamePath, profile.GameSwitch, profile.GameWorkingDirectory, waitForReady: false);
            return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(true, 0, $"Launched {profile.DisplayTitle} and companion trainer");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return new StoreTrainerLaunchResult(false, 5, $"Could not start program:\n{ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    // Starts an executable with its switches (preserving multi-flag arguments cleanly without
    // wrapping switches inside extra quotes!) and sets WorkingDirectory to its parent folder
    // unless a custom working folder was specified.
    private static void StartProgram(string exePath, string switches, string customWorkingDir, bool waitForReady)
    {
        var workingDir = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(customWorkingDir) && Directory.Exists(customWorkingDir)
            ? customWorkingDir
            : Path.GetDirectoryName(exePath) ?? string.Empty;

        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo
        {
            FileName = exePath,
            Arguments = switches?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            WorkingDirectory = workingDir,
            UseShellExecute = true
        };

        using var proc = Process.Start(psi);
        if (waitForReady && proc is not null)
        {
            try
            {
                // Wait up to 4 seconds for the first program's window message loop to become ready.
                // Wrapped in try/catch because console launchers or elevated UAC processes may not
                // expose a GUI input loop to WaitForInputIdle.
                proc.WaitForInputIdle(4000);
            }
            catch
            {
                // Safe to proceed immediately if target has no standard Win32 GUI message loop.
            }
        }
    }

    // Updates '[Recent] File1..File5' inside 'TStore.ini' so recent files stay synchronized with VB6 v1.1!
    private void RecordRecentStoreFile(string filePath)
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(ClassicAppDataDirectory);
            var iniData = File.Exists(ClassicIniFilePath)
                ? ReadIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath)
                : new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            var recent = new List<string> { filePath };
            for (var i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
            {
                var existing = GetIniValue(iniData, "Recent", $"File{i}", string.Empty);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(existing) &&
                    !recent.Contains(existing, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    recent.Add(existing);
                }
            }

            for (var i = 0; i < Math.Min(5, recent.Count); i++)
            {
                SetIniValue(iniData, "Recent", $"File{i + 1}", recent[i]);
            }

            WriteIniSections(ClassicIniFilePath, iniData);
        }
        catch
        {
            // Ignore non-critical MRU write issues
        }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // ZERO-DEPENDENCY CLASSIC WINDOWS INI READER / WRITER
    // =========================================================================

    private static Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>> ReadIniSections(string path)
    {
        var result = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var currentSection = "General";
        result[currentSection] = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        foreach (var rawLine in File.ReadAllLines(path))
        {
            var line = rawLine.Trim();
            if (line.Length == 0 || line.StartsWith(';'))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (line.StartsWith('[') && line.EndsWith(']') && line.Length > 2)
            {
                currentSection = line[1..^1].Trim();
                if (!result.ContainsKey(currentSection))
                {
                    result[currentSection] = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                }
                continue;
            }

            var eqIdx = line.IndexOf('=');
            if (eqIdx > 0)
            {
                var key = line[..eqIdx].Trim();
                var val = line[(eqIdx + 1)..].Trim();
                result[currentSection][key] = val;
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    private static void WriteIniSections(string path, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>> sections)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var (sectionName, kvps) in sections)
        {
            if (kvps.Count == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            sb.Append('[').Append(sectionName).AppendLine("]");
            foreach (var (key, val) in kvps)
            {
                sb.Append(key).Append('=').AppendLine(val ?? string.Empty);
            }
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        // Write UTF-8 without BOM so classic ANSI Win32 'GetPrivateProfileStringA' in VB6 v1.1
        // reads the '[General]' header on line 1 cleanly without seeing 3 invisible BOM bytes!
        File.WriteAllText(path, sb.ToString(), new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false));
    }

    private static string GetIniValue(
        Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>> sections,
        string section,
        string key,
        string defaultValue)
    {
        if (sections.TryGetValue(section, out var dict) && dict.TryGetValue(key, out var val))
        {
            return val;
        }
        return defaultValue;
    }

    private static void SetIniValue(
        Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>> sections,
        string section,
        string key,
        string value)
    {
        if (!sections.TryGetValue(section, out var dict))
        {
            dict = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            sections[section] = dict;
        }
        dict[key] = value;
    }

    private static bool ParseIniBool(string raw) =>
        string.Equals(raw, "true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        string.Equals(raw, "1", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        string.Equals(raw, "yes", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private static int CompareDottedVersions(string v1, string v2)
    {
        var p1 = v1.Split('.');
        var p2 = v2.Split('.');
        var len = Math.Max(p1.Length, p2.Length);
        for (var i = 0; i < len; i++)
        {
            var n1 = i < p1.Length && int.TryParse(p1[i], out var a) ? a : 0;
            var n2 = i < p2.Length && int.TryParse(p2[i], out var b) ? b : 0;
            if (n1 != n2)
            {
                return n1.CompareTo(n2);
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
}

MainWindow.xaml (StoreTrainer 2.0 — Two-Column Library & Profile Editor Layout)

[StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern)]

Accessible desktop layout with live search, Favorites pinning, drag-and-drop game/trainer cards, and Light/Dark theme support.

<!--
================================================================================
FILE: MainWindow.xaml
PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0 (StoreTrainer.csproj)
LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation & Creative Content)

PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
  What is this file?
    MainWindow.xaml defines the visual desktop window for RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0.
    If you have built web interfaces in HTML + CSS, think of this XAML file as a
    clean, responsive 3-row CSS Grid layout:
      - Row 0 (Top App Header): StoreTrainer icon, title, live profile count,
        My StoreFiles folder buttons, Theme switcher (System / Dark / Light),
        and About & Legal Notice button.
      - Row 1 (Main Two-Column Workspace):
          * Left Sidebar: Instant search box, Category/Favorites dropdown filter,
            New Profile & Open Existing File buttons, and a live clickable list
            of every '.stf' game profile in your 'My StoreFiles' folder!
          * Right Profile Editor & Launcher: One-click 'Launch Game & Trainer'
            primary button, Save / Save As / Duplicate / Remove toolbar, Launch
            Order & Timing options, Game Program card (supports drag-and-drop!),
            Companion Trainer card with optional Trainer Safety Check, Hotkey
            Notes box, and the scrollable RaggieSoft Work of Fiction & Licensing
            notice.
      - Row 2 (Bottom Status Bar): Friendly live status message and active library
        folder readout.

  Screen-Reader & Keyboard Accessibility:
    Every interactive control carries a clear 'AutomationProperties.Name' label
    (WPF's desktop equivalent of HTML 'aria-label') for Windows Narrator, JAWS,
    and NVDA, and uses '{DynamicResource ...}' Fluent brushes so Light Mode,
    Dark Mode, and Windows High-Contrast themes all maintain crisp readability.
================================================================================
-->
<Window x:Class="StoreTrainer.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        mc:Ignorable="d"
        Title="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer — PC Game &amp; Trainer Organizer"
        Icon="Assets/StoreTrainer.png"
        Width="1240"
        Height="840"
        MinWidth="860"
        MinHeight="600"
        AllowDrop="True"
        Drop="Window_OnDrop"
        DragOver="Window_OnDragOver"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        AutomationProperties.Name="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer Application">

    <!--
      OUTER 3-ROW GRID:
      - Row 0 (Auto): Top application bar
      - Row 1 (*):    Main two-column split workspace (expands to fill window height)
      - Row 2 (Auto): Bottom status bar
    -->
    <Grid Margin="14">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
            <RowDefinition Height="*" />
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- ===================================================================
             ROW 0: TOP APPLICATION HEADER BAR
             =================================================================== -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0"
                Padding="16,11"
                CornerRadius="8"
                BorderThickness="1"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}"
                Margin="0,0,0,12">
            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False">
                <!-- Left Branding: StoreTrainer Icon + Title + Subtitle -->
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Image Source="Assets/StoreTrainer.png"
                           Width="40"
                           Height="40"
                           Margin="0,0,14,0"
                           RenderOptions.BitmapScalingMode="HighQuality" />
                    <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock Text="RaggieSoft StoreTrainer"
                                       FontSize="19"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            <Border CornerRadius="4"
                                    Padding="8,2"
                                    Margin="10,0,0,0"
                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                    VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="Version 2.0"
                                           FontSize="11.5"
                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                           Opacity="0.88" />
                            </Border>
                        </StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="LibrarySummaryText"
                                   Text="Organize and launch your classic and modern PC games alongside their companion trainers"
                                   FontSize="12.5"
                                   Opacity="0.78"
                                   Margin="0,2,0,0" />
                    </StackPanel>
                </StackPanel>

                <!-- Right Header Actions: Library Folder, Theme Toggle, Website, About & Legal -->
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <Button x:Name="OpenLibraryFolderButton"
                            Content="📂 Open My StoreFiles"
                            Padding="11,6"
                            Margin="0,0,8,0"
                            Click="OpenLibraryFolderButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="Open your saved My StoreFiles folder in File Explorer"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Open My StoreFiles Folder" />
                    <Button x:Name="ChangeLibraryFolderButton"
                            Content="📁 Choose Library Folder..."
                            Padding="11,6"
                            Margin="0,0,8,0"
                            Click="ChangeLibraryFolderButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="Choose a different folder for your saved StoreFiles"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Choose StoreFiles Library Folder" />
                    <Button x:Name="ThemeToggleButton"
                            Content="🌓 Theme: System"
                            Padding="11,6"
                            Margin="0,0,8,0"
                            Click="ThemeToggleButton_OnClick"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="Switch Color Theme" />
                    <Button Content="ℹ️ About &amp; Legal"
                            Padding="11,6"
                            Click="AboutAndLegalButton_OnClick"
                            ToolTip="About RaggieSoft StoreTrainer &amp; Work of Fiction Notice"
                            AutomationProperties.Name="About RaggieSoft StoreTrainer and Work of Fiction Notice" />
                </StackPanel>
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- ===================================================================
             ROW 1: MAIN TWO-COLUMN SPLIT WORKSPACE (LIBRARY SIDEBAR + EDITOR)
             =================================================================== -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,0,0,10">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <!-- Left Column: Saved StoreFiles Library Sidebar (330 DIPs wide) -->
                <ColumnDefinition Width="335" />
                <ColumnDefinition Width="14" />
                <!-- Right Column: Selected Profile Editor & One-Click Launcher -->
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- ...............................................................
                 LEFT COLUMN: SAVED STOREFILES LIBRARY SIDEBAR
                 ............................................................... -->
            <Border Grid.Column="0"
                    Padding="12"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    BorderThickness="1"
                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                    Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
                        <RowDefinition Height="*" />
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Sidebar Action Buttons: New Profile + Open Any .stf File -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="8" />
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button x:Name="NewProfileButton"
                                Grid.Column="0"
                                Content="➕ New Game Profile"
                                Padding="10,7"
                                FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"
                                Click="NewProfileButton_OnClick"
                                AutomationProperties.Name="Create New Game Profile" />
                        <Button x:Name="ImportProfileButton"
                                Grid.Column="2"
                                Content="📂 Open File..."
                                Padding="10,7"
                                Click="ImportProfileButton_OnClick"
                                ToolTip="Open a .stf StoreFile from anywhere on your computer"
                                AutomationProperties.Name="Open StoreFile from Computer" />
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- Instant Library Search Box -->
                    <TextBox x:Name="LibrarySearchBox"
                             Grid.Row="1"
                             Padding="8,6"
                             Margin="0,0,0,8"
                             TextChanged="LibrarySearchBox_OnTextChanged"
                             ToolTip="Search saved profiles by game title, category, or notes"
                             AutomationProperties.Name="Search Saved Game Profiles" />

                    <!-- Category & Favorites Filter Dropdown -->
                    <ComboBox x:Name="LibraryCategoryFilterCombo"
                              Grid.Row="2"
                              SelectedIndex="0"
                              Margin="0,0,0,10"
                              SelectionChanged="LibraryCategoryFilterCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                              AutomationProperties.Name="Filter Saved Profiles by Category">
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="All Saved Profiles" Tag="ALL" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="★ Favorites Only" Tag="FAVORITES" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="General" Tag="General" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Action &amp; Adventure" Tag="Action &amp; Adventure" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Role-Playing (RPG)" Tag="Role-Playing (RPG)" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Strategy &amp; Simulation" Tag="Strategy &amp; Simulation" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Retro &amp; Classic PC" Tag="Retro &amp; Classic PC" />
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Sports &amp; Racing" Tag="Sports &amp; Racing" />
                    </ComboBox>

                    <!-- Scrollable List of Saved StoreFile Profiles -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="3">
                        <ListBox x:Name="ProfilesListBox"
                                 SelectionChanged="ProfilesListBox_OnSelectionChanged"
                                 HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch"
                                 ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled"
                                 AutomationProperties.Name="Saved StoreFiles List">
                            <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                                <DataTemplate>
                                    <Border Padding="8,7" Margin="0,2">
                                        <StackPanel>
                                            <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">
                                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                           Text="{Binding FileNameBadge}"
                                                           FontSize="10.5"
                                                           Opacity="0.65"
                                                           Margin="8,0,0,0"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding DisplayTitle}"
                                                           FontSize="13.5"
                                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                           TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                            </DockPanel>
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding SubtitleSummary}"
                                                       FontSize="11.5"
                                                       Opacity="0.76"
                                                       Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                       TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Border>
                                </DataTemplate>
                            </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        </ListBox>

                        <!-- Friendly Empty-State Helper Shown When No Profiles Match -->
                        <TextBlock x:Name="EmptyLibraryText"
                                   Text="No saved game profiles yet.&#x0a;&#x0a;Click &quot;➕ New Game Profile&quot; above — or drag and drop any game .exe or .stf file right onto this window to get started!"
                                   TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                   TextAlignment="Center"
                                   Opacity="0.72"
                                   FontSize="12.5"
                                   Margin="18"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   IsHitTestVisible="False"
                                   Visibility="Collapsed" />
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </Border>

            <!-- ...............................................................
                 RIGHT COLUMN: PROFILE EDITOR & ONE-CLICK LAUNCHER
                 ............................................................... -->
            <ScrollViewer Grid.Column="2"
                          VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                          HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                <StackPanel>

                    <!-- 1. TOP PROFILE ACTION BAR (LAUNCH, SAVE, DUPLICATE, DELETE) -->
                    <Border Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <DockPanel LastChildFill="False">
                            <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Left" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="ProfileHeaderTitleText"
                                               Text="Untitled Game Profile"
                                               FontSize="18"
                                               FontWeight="Bold"
                                               Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                    <Border x:Name="UnsavedBadgeBorder"
                                            CornerRadius="4"
                                            Padding="7,2"
                                            BorderThickness="1"
                                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Visibility="Collapsed">
                                        <TextBlock Text="Unsaved Changes"
                                                   FontSize="11"
                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                                    </Border>
                                </WrapPanel>
                                <CheckBox x:Name="FavoriteCheckBox"
                                          Content="★ Pin this game to the top of my Favorites list"
                                          Margin="0,6,0,0"
                                          Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                          Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                          AutomationProperties.Name="Pin Profile as Favorite" />
                            </StackPanel>

                            <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <Button x:Name="LaunchNowButton"
                                        Content="▶ Launch Game &amp; Trainer"
                                        Padding="16,9"
                                        Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                        FontWeight="Bold"
                                        Click="LaunchNowButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Save if needed and launch your game and companion trainer"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Launch Game and Trainer" />
                                <Button x:Name="SaveProfileButton"
                                        Content="💾 Save"
                                        Padding="12,9"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                        Click="SaveProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Save Game Profile" />
                                <Button x:Name="SaveAsProfileButton"
                                        Content="Save As..."
                                        Padding="11,9"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                        Click="SaveAsProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Save Game Profile As New File" />
                                <Button x:Name="DuplicateProfileButton"
                                        Content="📋 Duplicate"
                                        Padding="11,9"
                                        Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                        Click="DuplicateProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Create a copy of this profile (handy for testing different launch options)"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Duplicate Game Profile" />
                                <Button x:Name="DeleteProfileButton"
                                        Content="🗑 Delete"
                                        Padding="11,9"
                                        Click="DeleteProfileButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Delete this saved .stf profile from your library"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Delete Game Profile" />
                            </WrapPanel>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- 2. GENERAL PROFILE DETAILS & LAUNCH TIMING CARD -->
                    <Border Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="1. Profile Name &amp; Launch Order"
                                       FontSize="15"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,10" />

                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,12">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="2*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="12" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Display Title (shown in your library list):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="ProfileDisplayNameBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Profile Display Title" />
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Category:"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="ProfileCategoryCombo"
                                              IsEditable="True"
                                              Padding="8,5"
                                              SelectionChanged="ProfileCategoryCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                                              LostFocus="ProfileCategoryCombo_OnLostFocus"
                                              AutomationProperties.Name="Profile Category">
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="General" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Action &amp; Adventure" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Role-Playing (RPG)" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Strategy &amp; Simulation" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Retro &amp; Classic PC" />
                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Sports &amp; Racing" />
                                    </ComboBox>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>

                            <!-- Mutually-Exclusive Launch Sequence Checkboxes + Smart Wait + Delay -->
                            <CheckBox x:Name="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox"
                                      Content="Trainer starts the game automatically (only launch the trainer program)"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                      Checked="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Trainer Starts the Game Automatically" />

                            <CheckBox x:Name="LaunchGameFirstCheckBox"
                                      Content="Start the game first, then open the trainer after the game starts"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                      Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Start the Game First Before Trainer" />

                            <CheckBox x:Name="WaitForGameReadyCheckBox"
                                      Content="Wait until the first window finishes opening before starting the second program"
                                      IsChecked="True"
                                      Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                      Checked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      Unchecked="EditorField_OnChanged"
                                      AutomationProperties.Name="Wait Until First Window Finishes Opening" />

                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="Extra pause between programs:"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                           FontSize="12.5"
                                           Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                <ComboBox x:Name="LaunchDelayCombo"
                                          Width="175"
                                          SelectedIndex="0"
                                          SelectionChanged="LaunchDelayCombo_OnSelectionChanged"
                                          AutomationProperties.Name="Extra Pause Between Programs">
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="None (0 seconds)" Tag="0" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="2 seconds" Tag="2" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="5 seconds" Tag="5" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="10 seconds" Tag="10" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="15 seconds" Tag="15" />
                                    <ComboBoxItem Content="30 seconds" Tag="30" />
                                </ComboBox>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- 3. GAME PROGRAM CARD (SUPPORTS DRAGGING & DROPPING A GAME .EXE) -->
                    <Border x:Name="GameSectionBorder"
                            Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            AllowDrop="True"
                            Drop="GameSectionBorder_OnDrop"
                            DragOver="Window_OnDragOver"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                           Text="2. Game Program (you can drag and drop your game file here)"
                                           FontSize="15"
                                           FontWeight="Bold"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                <TextBlock x:Name="GameStatusText"
                                           DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                           Text=""
                                           FontSize="12"
                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            </DockPanel>

                            <TextBlock Text="Game Program File:"
                                       FontSize="12"
                                       Opacity="0.84"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="8" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="6" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <TextBox x:Name="GamePathBox"
                                         Grid.Column="0"
                                         Padding="8,6"
                                         TextChanged="GamePathBox_OnTextChanged"
                                         AutomationProperties.Name="Game Program File Path" />
                                <Button x:Name="BrowseGameButton"
                                        Grid.Column="2"
                                        Content="Browse..."
                                        Padding="12,6"
                                        Click="BrowseGameButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Browse for Game Program" />
                                <Button x:Name="OpenGameFolderButton"
                                        Grid.Column="4"
                                        Content="📂 Folder"
                                        Padding="10,6"
                                        Click="OpenGameFolderButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Open the game's folder in File Explorer"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Open Game Folder" />
                            </Grid>

                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="12" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Optional Game Launch Options (for example: -windowed -novid):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="GameSwitchBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Optional Game Launch Options" />
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Optional Starting Folder Override (leave blank for automatic):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="GameWorkingDirBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Optional Game Starting Folder" />
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- 4. COMPANION TRAINER CARD + TRAINER FILE VERIFICATION -->
                    <Border x:Name="TrainerSectionBorder"
                            Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            AllowDrop="True"
                            Drop="TrainerSectionBorder_OnDrop"
                            DragOver="Window_OnDragOver"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                           Text="3. Companion Trainer Program (drag and drop your trainer file here)"
                                           FontSize="15"
                                           FontWeight="Bold"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TrainerStatusText"
                                           DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                           Text=""
                                           FontSize="12"
                                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            </DockPanel>

                            <TextBlock Text="Trainer Program File:"
                                       FontSize="12"
                                       Opacity="0.84"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="8" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="6" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <TextBox x:Name="TrainerPathBox"
                                         Grid.Column="0"
                                         Padding="8,6"
                                         TextChanged="TrainerPathBox_OnTextChanged"
                                         AutomationProperties.Name="Trainer Program File Path" />
                                <Button x:Name="BrowseTrainerButton"
                                        Grid.Column="2"
                                        Content="Browse..."
                                        Padding="12,6"
                                        Click="BrowseTrainerButton_OnClick"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Browse for Trainer Program" />
                                <Button x:Name="OpenTrainerFolderButton"
                                        Grid.Column="4"
                                        Content="📂 Folder"
                                        Padding="10,6"
                                        Click="OpenTrainerFolderButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Open the trainer's folder in File Explorer"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Open Trainer Folder" />
                            </Grid>

                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="12" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Optional Trainer Launch Options:"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="TrainerSwitchBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Optional Trainer Launch Options" />
                                </StackPanel>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2">
                                    <TextBlock Text="Optional Trainer Starting Folder Override (leave blank for automatic):"
                                               FontSize="12"
                                               Opacity="0.84"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                                    <TextBox x:Name="TrainerWorkingDirBox"
                                             Padding="8,6"
                                             TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                             AutomationProperties.Name="Optional Trainer Starting Folder" />
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>

                            <!-- Trainer Safety Verification Row -->
                            <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <CheckBox x:Name="VerifyTrainerCheckBox"
                                          Content="Warn me before launching if this trainer file ever changes on disk"
                                          VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                          Margin="0,0,12,0"
                                          Checked="VerifyTrainerCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                          Unchecked="VerifyTrainerCheckBox_OnChanged"
                                          AutomationProperties.Name="Warn Before Launching If Trainer File Changes" />
                                <Button x:Name="PinTrainerFingerprintButton"
                                        Content="🛡 Remember Trusted Trainer File"
                                        Padding="10,5"
                                        Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                        Click="PinTrainerFingerprintButton_OnClick"
                                        ToolTip="Record a safety snapshot of your current trainer file so StoreTrainer can warn you if the file is ever altered"
                                        AutomationProperties.Name="Remember Trusted Trainer File" />
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TrainerFingerprintStatusText"
                                           Text="No trusted trainer snapshot recorded yet"
                                           FontSize="11.5"
                                           Opacity="0.76"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            </WrapPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- 5. TRAINER HOTKEY & CHEAT NOTES CARD -->
                    <Border Padding="16,14"
                            Margin="0,0,0,12"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="4. Personal Hotkey &amp; Launch Notes"
                                       FontSize="15"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,6" />
                            <TextBlock Text="Jot down trainer shortcut keys (for example: F1 = Unlimited Health, F2 = Gold) so you never have to hunt for old readme files:"
                                       FontSize="12"
                                       Opacity="0.82"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,8" />
                            <TextBox x:Name="ProfileNotesBox"
                                     AcceptsReturn="True"
                                     TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                     MinHeight="76"
                                     MaxHeight="150"
                                     VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                     Padding="8,6"
                                     TextChanged="EditorTextBox_OnTextChanged"
                                     AutomationProperties.Name="Personal Hotkey and Launch Notes" />
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- 6. MANDATORY SCROLLABLE WORK OF FICTION & LICENSING FOOTER -->
                    <Border Padding="14,12"
                            Margin="0,0,0,4"
                            CornerRadius="8"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="ScrollableFooterTitleText"
                                       FontSize="11"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Opacity="0.82"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                            <TextBlock x:Name="ScrollableFooterBodyText"
                                       FontSize="11.5"
                                       Opacity="0.78"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,4" />
                            <TextBlock x:Name="ScrollableFooterLicenseText"
                                       FontSize="11"
                                       Opacity="0.72"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                </StackPanel>
            </ScrollViewer>
        </Grid>

        <!-- ===================================================================
             ROW 2: BOTTOM STATUS & LIBRARY FOLDER BAR
             =================================================================== -->
        <Border Grid.Row="2"
                Padding="14,8"
                CornerRadius="8"
                BorderThickness="1"
                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource ControlStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}">
            <DockPanel LastChildFill="False">
                <TextBlock x:Name="StatusBannerText"
                           DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                           Text="✅ Ready"
                           FontSize="12.5"
                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                <TextBlock x:Name="ActiveLibraryPathText"
                           DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                           Text="📂 My StoreFiles"
                           FontSize="11.5"
                           Opacity="0.78"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>
    </Grid>
