</Window>

MainWindow.xaml.cs (StoreTrainer 2.0 — Interactive Library & Editor Controller)

[StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern)]

Handles instant library filtering, drag-and-drop .stf/.exe files, unsaved-change guards, and one-click game + trainer launching.

// ================================================================================
// FILE: MainWindow.xaml.cs
// PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0 (StoreTrainer.csproj)
// LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation & Creative Content)
//
// PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
//   What is this file?
//     This is the C# controller ("code-behind") paired with MainWindow.xaml. Every
//     button click, search keystroke, drag-and-drop gesture, and theme switch in
//     StoreTrainer 2.0 is handled right here:
//       1. Automatic Library Discovery: Scans your 'Documents\My StoreFiles' folder
//          (or any existing custom folder saved in classic 'TStore.ini') and binds
//          every '.stf' game profile to the left-hand sidebar list.
//       2. Unsaved-Changes Guard: Tracks whether you have edited fields on the right
//          without saving yet, prompting politely before switching profiles or closing
//          the window so you never lose work by accident.
//       3. Drag-and-Drop Convenience: Drop a '.stf' file anywhere on the window to
//          open it, or drop a '.exe' file onto the Game or Trainer card to fill in
//          its path and title automatically!
//       4. Mutual-Exclusivity Enforcement: Checking "Trainer starts the game
//          automatically" automatically disables the separate Game fields and
//          unchecks "Start the game first", fulfilling the exact design rule first
//          noted in classic StoreTrainer's 2018 developer notes.
// ================================================================================

using System.ComponentModel;    // 'CancelEventArgs' for intercepting window close when unsaved edits exist.
using System.Diagnostics;       // 'Process.Start' for opening folders in Windows File Explorer.
using System.IO;                // 'File', 'Directory', and 'Path' helpers.
using System.Windows;           // Core WPF window, drag-and-drop, and dialog classes.
using System.Windows.Controls;  // 'ListBox', 'ComboBoxItem', 'TextChangedEventArgs', etc.
using Microsoft.Win32;          // Native Windows 'OpenFileDialog', 'SaveFileDialog', and 'OpenFolderDialog'.
using RaggieSoft.Core.Models;   // 'RaggieSoftLegalCopy' for the Work of Fiction & Licensing notice.
using RaggieSoft.Core.Services; // 'RaggieSoftWorkspaceLocator' for first-run legal notice persistence.
using RaggieSoft.SharedWpf;     // 'RaggieSoftWpfDialogs' for shared First-Run & About modals.
using StoreTrainer.Models;      // 'StoreFileProfile' data model.
using StoreTrainer.Services;    // 'StoreTrainerService' INI & process launcher engine.

namespace StoreTrainer;

#pragma warning disable WPF0001 // Fluent ThemeMode API in .NET 10 WPF

public partial class MainWindow : Window
{
    private readonly RaggieSoftWorkspaceLocator _locator = new();
    private readonly StoreTrainerService _service = new();

    // Active library folder path (defaults to 'Documents\My StoreFiles').
    private string _libraryFolder = string.Empty;
    // Complete list of '.stf' profiles loaded from '_libraryFolder'.
    private List<StoreFileProfile> _allProfiles = [];
    // Currently edited profile in the right-hand pane.
    private StoreFileProfile _currentProfile = new();

    // Guard flag set to 'true' while C# is populating TextBoxes/CheckBoxes from a profile
    // so programmatic updates don't falsely trigger the "Unsaved Changes" badge!
    private bool _isBindingEditor;
    // Guard flag preventing SelectionChanged recursion when restoring a ListBox selection.
    private bool _isUpdatingSelection;
    // True when the user has modified fields in the editor since the last save/load.
    private bool _isDirty;
    // Current color theme label ("System", "Dark", or "Light").
    private string _currentThemeLabel = "System";

    public MainWindow()
    {
        InitializeComponent();

        // Populate the mandatory RaggieSoft Work of Fiction & Creative Licensing footer.
        ScrollableFooterTitleText.Text = RaggieSoftLegalCopy.FictitiousDisclaimerTitle.ToUpperInvariant();
        ScrollableFooterBodyText.Text = RaggieSoftLegalCopy.FictitiousDisclaimerBody;
        ScrollableFooterLicenseText.Text = RaggieSoftLegalCopy.CreativeLicenseSummary;

        ApplyThemeByName(_service.GetSavedThemePreference(), persist: false);

        Loaded += MainWindow_OnLoaded;
        Closing += MainWindow_OnClosing;
    }

    // Runs once the StoreTrainer window appears on screen.
    private void MainWindow_OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        // Show the one-time First-Run Work of Fiction acknowledgement modal if not yet accepted.
        RaggieSoftWpfDialogs.EnsureFirstRunFictionNoticeAcknowledged(this, _locator);

        _libraryFolder = _service.EnsureLibraryFolder();
        ActiveLibraryPathText.Text = $"📂 Library: {_libraryFolder}";

        ReloadLibraryList(selectFilePath: App.StartupEditProfilePath);

        // If StoreTrainer was invoked with '/e "C:\SomeOtherFolder\Game.stf"' outside My StoreFiles,
        // load that external '.stf' directly into the editor pane!
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(App.StartupEditProfilePath) &&
            File.Exists(App.StartupEditProfilePath) &&
            !string.Equals(_currentProfile.FilePath, App.StartupEditProfilePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            OpenExternalStoreFileIntoEditor(App.StartupEditProfilePath);
        }
    }

    // Prompts to save if the user clicks the window's [X] close button with unsaved edits.
    private void MainWindow_OnClosing(object? sender, CancelEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!ConfirmDiscardOrSaveUnsavedChanges())
        {
            e.Cancel = true;
        }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // LIBRARY DISCOVERY, SEARCH & FILTERING
    // =========================================================================

    private void ReloadLibraryList(string? selectFilePath = null)
    {
        _allProfiles = _service.LoadLibraryProfiles(_libraryFolder);
        LibrarySummaryText.Text = _allProfiles.Count == 1
            ? "1 saved game profile in My StoreFiles • Compatible with StoreTrainer 1.0, 1.1 & 2.0"
            : $"{_allProfiles.Count} saved game profiles in My StoreFiles • Compatible with StoreTrainer 1.0, 1.1 & 2.0";

        ApplyLibraryFilter(selectFilePath);
    }

    private void ApplyLibraryFilter(string? selectFilePath = null)
    {
        var search = LibrarySearchBox?.Text.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        var categoryTag = (LibraryCategoryFilterCombo?.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Tag as string ?? "ALL";

        IEnumerable<StoreFileProfile> filtered = _allProfiles;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
        {
            filtered = filtered.Where(p =>
                p.DisplayTitle.Contains(search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                p.Category.Contains(search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                p.Notes.Contains(search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                p.FileNameBadge.Contains(search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        filtered = categoryTag switch
        {
            "ALL" => filtered,
            "FAVORITES" => filtered.Where(p => p.IsFavorite),
            _ => filtered.Where(p => string.Equals(p.Category, categoryTag, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        };

        var visibleList = filtered.ToList();
        _isUpdatingSelection = true;
        try
        {
            ProfilesListBox.ItemsSource = visibleList;
            EmptyLibraryText.Visibility = visibleList.Count == 0 ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;

            StoreFileProfile? target = null;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(selectFilePath))
            {
                target = visibleList.FirstOrDefault(p =>
                    string.Equals(p.FilePath, selectFilePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }
            target ??= visibleList.FirstOrDefault();

            if (target is not null)
            {
                ProfilesListBox.SelectedItem = target;
                BindProfileToEditor(target.Clone(), markDirty: false);
            }
            else if (_allProfiles.Count == 0)
            {
                BindProfileToEditor(new StoreFileProfile(), markDirty: false);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            _isUpdatingSelection = false;
        }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // TWO-WAY PROFILE <-> EDITOR FORM BINDING
    // =========================================================================

    private void BindProfileToEditor(StoreFileProfile profile, bool markDirty)
    {
        _isBindingEditor = true;
        try
        {
            _currentProfile = profile;

            ProfileDisplayNameBox.Text = profile.DisplayName;
            ProfileCategoryCombo.Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.Category) ? "General" : profile.Category;
            FavoriteCheckBox.IsChecked = profile.IsFavorite;

            TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox.IsChecked = profile.TrainerLaunchesGame;
            LaunchGameFirstCheckBox.IsChecked = !profile.TrainerLaunchesGame && profile.LaunchGameFirst;
            WaitForGameReadyCheckBox.IsChecked = profile.WaitForGameReady;
            SelectDelayComboBySeconds(profile.LaunchDelaySeconds);

            GamePathBox.Text = profile.GamePath;
            GameSwitchBox.Text = profile.GameSwitch;
            GameWorkingDirBox.Text = profile.GameWorkingDirectory;

            TrainerPathBox.Text = profile.TrainerPath;
            TrainerSwitchBox.Text = profile.TrainerSwitch;
            TrainerWorkingDirBox.Text = profile.TrainerWorkingDirectory;
            VerifyTrainerCheckBox.IsChecked = profile.VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch;

            ProfileNotesBox.Text = profile.Notes;

            UpdateGameSectionEnabledState();
            UpdatePathValidationBadges();
            UpdateTrainerFingerprintStatusLabel();
            DeleteProfileButton.IsEnabled = !profile.IsUnsavedNew;

            SetDirtyState(markDirty);
        }
        finally
        {
            _isBindingEditor = false;
        }
    }

    private void ReadEditorIntoCurrentProfile()
    {
        _currentProfile.DisplayName = ProfileDisplayNameBox.Text.Trim();
        _currentProfile.Category = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ProfileCategoryCombo.Text)
            ? "General"
            : ProfileCategoryCombo.Text.Trim();
        _currentProfile.IsFavorite = FavoriteCheckBox.IsChecked == true;

        _currentProfile.TrainerLaunchesGame = TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox.IsChecked == true;
        _currentProfile.LaunchGameFirst = !_currentProfile.TrainerLaunchesGame &&
                                          LaunchGameFirstCheckBox.IsChecked == true;
        _currentProfile.WaitForGameReady = WaitForGameReadyCheckBox.IsChecked == true;

        var delayTag = (LaunchDelayCombo.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Tag as string ?? "0";
        _ = int.TryParse(delayTag, out var delaySeconds);
        _currentProfile.LaunchDelaySeconds = delaySeconds;

        _currentProfile.GamePath = GamePathBox.Text.Trim();
        _currentProfile.GameSwitch = GameSwitchBox.Text.Trim();
        _currentProfile.GameWorkingDirectory = GameWorkingDirBox.Text.Trim();

        _currentProfile.TrainerPath = TrainerPathBox.Text.Trim();
        _currentProfile.TrainerSwitch = TrainerSwitchBox.Text.Trim();
        _currentProfile.TrainerWorkingDirectory = TrainerWorkingDirBox.Text.Trim();
        _currentProfile.VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch = VerifyTrainerCheckBox.IsChecked == true;
        _currentProfile.Notes = ProfileNotesBox.Text;
    }

    private void SetDirtyState(bool dirty)
    {
        _isDirty = dirty;
        ReadEditorIntoCurrentProfile();
        ProfileHeaderTitleText.Text = _currentProfile.DisplayTitle;
        UnsavedBadgeBorder.Visibility = dirty ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
    }

    private void SelectDelayComboBySeconds(int seconds)
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < LaunchDelayCombo.Items.Count; i++)
        {
            if (LaunchDelayCombo.Items[i] is ComboBoxItem item &&
                int.TryParse(item.Tag as string, out var itemSec) &&
                itemSec >= seconds)
            {
                LaunchDelayCombo.SelectedIndex = i;
                return;
            }
        }
        LaunchDelayCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
    }

    private void UpdateGameSectionEnabledState()
    {
        var trainerStartsGame = TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox.IsChecked == true;
        if (trainerStartsGame)
        {
            LaunchGameFirstCheckBox.IsChecked = false;
        }

        LaunchGameFirstCheckBox.IsEnabled = !trainerStartsGame;
        GamePathBox.IsEnabled = !trainerStartsGame;
        BrowseGameButton.IsEnabled = !trainerStartsGame;
        GameSwitchBox.IsEnabled = !trainerStartsGame;
        GameWorkingDirBox.IsEnabled = !trainerStartsGame;
        GameSectionBorder.Opacity = trainerStartsGame ? 0.62 : 1.0;
    }

    private void UpdatePathValidationBadges()
    {
        var gamePath = GamePathBox.Text.Trim();
        if (TrainerLaunchesGameCheckBox.IsChecked == true)
        {
            GameStatusText.Text = "Started automatically by trainer";
        }
        else if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gamePath))
        {
            GameStatusText.Text = "Choose a game program";
        }
        else
        {
            GameStatusText.Text = File.Exists(gamePath) ? "✅ File found" : "⚠️ File not found on disk";
        }

        var trainerPath = TrainerPathBox.Text.Trim();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(trainerPath))
        {
            TrainerStatusText.Text = "Optional (or choose trainer)";
        }
        else
        {
            TrainerStatusText.Text = File.Exists(trainerPath) ? "✅ File found" : "⚠️ File not found on disk";
        }
    }

    private void UpdateTrainerFingerprintStatusLabel()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_currentProfile.TrainerFingerprint))
        {
            TrainerFingerprintStatusText.Text = "No trusted trainer snapshot recorded yet";
            return;
        }

        var shortCode = _currentProfile.TrainerFingerprint.Length >= 12
            ? _currentProfile.TrainerFingerprint[..12]
            : _currentProfile.TrainerFingerprint;
        TrainerFingerprintStatusText.Text = $"🛡 Trusted snapshot saved ({shortCode}…)";
    }

    // Checks if the current profile has unsaved changes and asks Yes / No / Cancel.
    // Returns true if safe to proceed, or false if the user canceled.
    private bool ConfirmDiscardOrSaveUnsavedChanges()
    {
        if (!_isDirty)
        {
            return true;
        }

        var result = MessageBox.Show(
            this,
            $"Would you like to save your changes to \"{_currentProfile.DisplayTitle}\"?",
            "Unsaved Changes — RaggieSoft StoreTrainer",
            MessageBoxButton.YesNoCancel,
            MessageBoxImage.Question,
            MessageBoxResult.Yes);

        if (result == MessageBoxResult.Cancel)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (result == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
        {
            return PerformSave(forceSaveAs: false);
        }

        return true;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // SAVE, SAVE AS, NEW, DUPLICATE, DELETE & LAUNCH HANDLERS
    // =========================================================================

    private bool PerformSave(bool forceSaveAs)
    {
        ReadEditorIntoCurrentProfile();

        var targetPath = _currentProfile.FilePath;
        if (forceSaveAs || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(targetPath))
        {
            var suggestedBase = MakeSafeFileName(
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_currentProfile.DisplayName)
                    ? _currentProfile.DisplayName
                    : !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_currentProfile.GamePath)
                        ? Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(_currentProfile.GamePath)
                        : "MyGame");

            var dlg = new SaveFileDialog
            {
                Title = "Save StoreFile Profile",
                Filter = "StoreTrainer Profile (*.stf)|*.stf",
                DefaultExt = ".stf",
                InitialDirectory = Directory.Exists(_libraryFolder) ? _libraryFolder : string.Empty,
                FileName = $"{suggestedBase}.stf"
            };

            if (dlg.ShowDialog(this) != true)
            {
                return false;
            }

            targetPath = dlg.FileName;
        }

        try
        {
            // If user checked "Warn me before launching" and a valid trainer exists without a snapshot yet,
            // automatically capture the snapshot right as we save!
            if (_currentProfile.VerifyTrainerBeforeLaunch &&
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_currentProfile.TrainerFingerprint) &&
                File.Exists(_currentProfile.TrainerPath))
            {
                _currentProfile.TrainerFingerprint = _service.ComputeFileFingerprint(_currentProfile.TrainerPath);
            }

            _service.SaveStoreFile(_currentProfile, targetPath);
            SetDirtyState(false);
            ReloadLibraryList(selectFilePath: targetPath);
            StatusBannerText.Text = $"💾 Saved {_currentProfile.DisplayTitle} ({Path.GetFileName(targetPath)})";
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                this,
                $"Could not save StoreFile:\n{ex.Message}",
                "Save Notice",
                MessageBoxButton.OK,
                MessageBoxImage.Warning);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void SaveProfileButton_OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        PerformSave(forceSaveAs: false);
    }

    private void SaveAsProfileButton_OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        PerformSave(forceSaveAs: true);
    }

        }

        _isUpdatingSelection = true;
        ProfilesListBox.SelectedItem = null;
        _isUpdatingSelection = false;

        BindProfileToEditor(new StoreFileProfile(), markDirty: false);
        ProfileDisplayNameBox.Focus();
        StatusBannerText.Text = "➕ Started a new game profile";
    }

        var dlg = new OpenFileDialog
        {
            Title = "Open StoreFile Profile",
            Filter = "StoreTrainer Profile (*.stf)|*.stf|All Files (*.*)|*.*",
            DefaultExt = ".stf",
            InitialDirectory = Directory.Exists(_libraryFolder) ? _libraryFolder : string.Empty
        };

            OpenExternalStoreFileIntoEditor(dlg.FileName);

    private void OpenExternalStoreFileIntoEditor(string filePath)
    {
        var res = _service.LoadStoreFile(filePath);
        if (!res.Success || res.Profile is null)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(this, res.ErrorMessage, "Open StoreFile", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
            return;
        }

        BindProfileToEditor(res.Profile, markDirty: false);
        StatusBannerText.Text = $"📂 Opened {res.Profile.DisplayTitle}";
    }

    private void DuplicateProfileButton_OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!ConfirmDiscardOrSaveUnsavedChanges())
        {
            return;
        }

        ReadEditorIntoCurrentProfile();
        var copy = _currentProfile.Clone();
        copy.FilePath = string.Empty;
        copy.DisplayName = $"{_currentProfile.DisplayTitle} (Copy)";

        _isUpdatingSelection = true;
        ProfilesListBox.SelectedItem = null;
        _isUpdatingSelection = false;

        BindProfileToEditor(copy, markDirty: true);
        StatusBannerText.Text = "📋 Created duplicate draft — click Save to add it to your library";
    }

    private void DeleteProfileButton_OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (_currentProfile.IsUnsavedNew || !File.Exists(_currentProfile.FilePath))
        {
            return;
        }

        var confirm = MessageBox.Show(
            this,
            $"Delete the saved profile \"{_currentProfile.DisplayTitle}\"?\n\n" +
            "(This only removes the StoreTrainer profile shortcut; your actual game and trainer files will not be touched.)",
            "Delete Game Profile",
            MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
            MessageBoxImage.Question,
            MessageBoxResult.No);

        if (confirm != MessageBoxResult.Yes)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            var deletedTitle = _currentProfile.DisplayTitle;
            File.Delete(_currentProfile.FilePath);
            _isDirty = false;
            ReloadLibraryList();
            StatusBannerText.Text = $"🗑 Deleted profile {deletedTitle}";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(this, $"Could not delete profile:\n{ex.Message}", "Delete Notice", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
        }
    }

    private async void LaunchNowButton_OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        ReadEditorIntoCurrentProfile();

        // Save automatically if already saved before, or ask to save first if brand new (matching classic StoreTrainer!).
        if (_isDirty || _currentProfile.IsUnsavedNew)
        {
            if (!PerformSave(forceSaveAs: false))
            {
                return;
            }
        }

        LaunchNowButton.IsEnabled = false;
        StatusBannerText.Text = $"⏳ Launching {_currentProfile.DisplayTitle}...";

        try
        {
            var result = await _service.LaunchProfileAsync(_currentProfile, prompt =>
            {
                var answer = MessageBox.Show(
                    this,
                    prompt,
                    "Trainer File Changed — RaggieSoft StoreTrainer",
                    MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
                    MessageBoxImage.Warning,
                    MessageBoxResult.No);
                return answer == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
            });

            if (result.Success)
            {
                StatusBannerText.Text = $"🚀 {result.Message}";
            }
            else
            {
                StatusBannerText.Text = $"⚠️ {result.Message}";
                MessageBox.Show(this, result.Message, "Launch Notice", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            LaunchNowButton.IsEnabled = true;
        }
    }

    private void Window_OnDragOver(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        e.Effects = e.Data.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.FileDrop)
            ? DragDropEffects.Copy
            : DragDropEffects.None;
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private void Window_OnDrop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Data.GetData(DataFormats.FileDrop) is not string[] files || files.Length == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        var first = files[0];
        if (first.EndsWith(".stf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            if (ConfirmDiscardOrSaveUnsavedChanges())
            {
                OpenExternalStoreFileIntoEditor(first);
            }
            e.Handled = true;
        }
        else if (first.EndsWith(".exe", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            AssignGameExecutable(first);
            StatusBannerText.Text = $"🎯 Set game program to {Path.GetFileName(first)}";
            e.Handled = true;
        }
    }

    private void GameSectionBorder_OnDrop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Data.GetData(DataFormats.FileDrop) is string[] files && files.Length > 0)
        {
            if (files[0].EndsWith(".stf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                if (ConfirmDiscardOrSaveUnsavedChanges())
                {
                    OpenExternalStoreFileIntoEditor(files[0]);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                AssignGameExecutable(files[0]);
                StatusBannerText.Text = $"🎯 Set game program to {Path.GetFileName(files[0])}";
            }
            e.Handled = true;
        }
    }

    private void TrainerSectionBorder_OnDrop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Data.GetData(DataFormats.FileDrop) is string[] files && files.Length > 0)

            {

                AssignTrainerExecutable(files[0]);
                StatusBannerText.Text = $"🎯 Set trainer program to {Path.GetFileName(files[0])}";
            }
            e.Handled = true;
        }
    }

    private void ThemeToggleButton_OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var next = _currentThemeLabel switch
        {
            "System" => "Dark",
            "Dark" => "Light",
            _ => "System"
        };
        ApplyThemeByName(next, persist: true);
    }

    private void ApplyThemeByName(string themeName, bool persist)
    {
        if (string.Equals(themeName, "Dark", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            Application.Current.ThemeMode = ThemeMode.Dark;
            _currentThemeLabel = "Dark";
        }
        else if (string.Equals(themeName, "Light", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            Application.Current.ThemeMode = ThemeMode.Light;
            _currentThemeLabel = "Light";
        }
        else
        {
            Application.Current.ThemeMode = ThemeMode.System;
            _currentThemeLabel = "System";
        }

        ThemeToggleButton.Content = $"🌓 Theme: {_currentThemeLabel}";
        if (persist)
        {
            _service.SaveThemePreference(_currentThemeLabel);
        }
    }

    private void AboutAndLegalButton_OnClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        RaggieSoftWpfDialogs.ShowAboutAndLegalDialog(this, "RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0", "RaggieSoft Media");
    }

    private static void OpenFolderInExplorer(string directoryPath)
    {
        try
        {
            Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
            {
                FileName = directoryPath,
                UseShellExecute = true
            });
        }
        catch
        {
            // Ignore shell launch error
        }
    }

    private static string MakeSafeFileName(string raw)
    {
        var invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars();
        var cleaned = new string(raw.Where(c => !invalid.Contains(c)).ToArray()).Trim();
        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cleaned) ? "MyGame" : cleaned;
    }
}

App.xaml.cs (StoreTrainer 2.0 — /l & /e Command-Line Switches & Shared Mutex)

[StoreTrainer 2.0 (Modern)]

Startup router supporting silent /l StoreFile launches from File Explorer, /e editor handoff, and shared running-instance detection.

// ================================================================================
// FILE: App.xaml.cs
// PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0 (StoreTrainer.csproj)
// LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation & Creative Content)
//
// PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
//   What is this file?
//     This is the C# startup coordinator that runs the instant 'StoreTrainer.exe'
//     starts on Windows — before any window appears on screen.
//
//   What three important jobs happen here?
//     1. Named OS Mutex ('RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex'):
//        Creates a named Windows kernel flag while StoreTrainer is running. Notice
//        we use the exact same Mutex name in BOTH classic VB6 StoreTrainer v1.1 AND
//        modern StoreTrainer 2.0! That means Inno Setup ('StoreTrainer.iss') and
//        NSIS ('TSSetup-Patch.nsi') both know if ANY generation of StoreTrainer is
//        currently open during an upgrade or uninstall.
//     2. Command-Line Switch Routing ('/l', '/e', '--version', and '.stf' paths):
//        - 'StoreTrainer.exe /l "C:\...\Doom.stf"': Loads that profile, starts the
//          game and trainer in the right order, and exits with code 0 (no editor
//          window flashed on screen!).
//        - 'StoreTrainer.exe /e "C:\...\Doom.stf"' (or a 'raggiesoft-storetrainer://'
//          deep link): Opens MainWindow with that profile selected for editing.
//        - 'StoreTrainer.exe --version': Writes version info to a small dialog/stdout
//          and exits cleanly.
//     3. Normal Interactive Launch:
//        Constructs and displays 'MainWindow' when launched from the Start Menu,
//        Desktop shortcut, or RaggieSoft Launcher.
// ================================================================================

using System.IO;                // 'File.Exists' and 'Path' helpers for inspecting '.stf' paths.
using System.Threading;         // 'Mutex' for installer/uninstaller running-instance detection.
using System.Windows;           // WPF 'Application', 'StartupEventArgs', 'ExitEventArgs', 'MessageBox'.
using StoreTrainer.Services;    // 'StoreTrainerService' for loading & launching '.stf' profiles.

namespace StoreTrainer;

public partial class App : Application
{
    // Shared Win32 Mutex name watched by both NSIS (v1.1) and Inno Setup 7 (v2.0).
    // Note: Avoiding a 'Local\' backslash prefix keeps the name 100% identical to
    // classic Win9x-compatible VB6 'CreateMutexA(0&, 0&, "RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex")'.
    public const string AppMutexName = "RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex";

    // Keeps the Mutex alive in memory until OnExit runs so the .NET Garbage Collector
    // never closes the kernel handle while MainWindow is still open.
    private Mutex? _instanceMutex;

    // Optional '.stf' file path passed via '/e "file.stf"' so MainWindow can auto-select
    // and open that profile as soon as the window finishes loading.
    public static string? StartupEditProfilePath { get; private set; }

    // Fires when StoreTrainer.exe starts up.
    protected override async void OnStartup(StartupEventArgs e)
    {
        // Step 1: Register the running-instance Mutex in Windows kernel memory.
        _instanceMutex = new Mutex(initiallyOwned: false, name: AppMutexName);

        base.OnStartup(e);

        // Step 2: Inspect command-line arguments ('e.Args' is everything typed after 'StoreTrainer.exe').
        if (e.Args.Length > 0)
        {
            var firstArg = e.Args[0].Trim();

            // Case A: '--version' diagnostic flag
            if (string.Equals(firstArg, "--version", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                string.Equals(firstArg, "/version", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                MessageBox.Show(
                    "RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v2.0.0\nCopyright © Michael P. Ragsdale (MIT License)",
                    "RaggieSoft StoreTrainer",
                    MessageBoxButton.OK,
                    MessageBoxImage.Information);
                Shutdown(0);
                return;
            }

            // Case B: '/l "path\to\profile.stf"' (or '-l') -> Fast-launch game & trainer, then exit!
            if ((string.Equals(firstArg, "/l", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 string.Equals(firstArg, "-l", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) &&
                e.Args.Length >= 2)
            {
                await LaunchProfileDirectlyAndShutdownAsync(e.Args[1]);
                return;
            }

            // Case C: '/e "path\to\profile.stf"' (or '-e') -> Open profile inside MainWindow editor!
            if ((string.Equals(firstArg, "/e", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 string.Equals(firstArg, "-e", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) &&
                e.Args.Length >= 2)
            {
                StartupEditProfilePath = e.Args[1].Trim('"');
            }
            // Case D: 'raggiesoft-storetrainer://edit?file=...' or 'raggiesoft-storetrainer://launch?file=...'
            else if (firstArg.StartsWith("raggiesoft-storetrainer://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                HandleCustomProtocolUri(firstArg, out var launchImmediatelyPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(launchImmediatelyPath))
                {
                    await LaunchProfileDirectlyAndShutdownAsync(launchImmediatelyPath);
                    return;
                }
            }
            // Case E: Bare '"C:\...\MyGame.stf"' passed directly (e.g., dragging a .stf onto StoreTrainer.exe)
            // -> Matches Windows Explorer double-click expectation: launch immediately!
            else if (firstArg.EndsWith(".stf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                     File.Exists(firstArg.Trim('"')))
            {
                await LaunchProfileDirectlyAndShutdownAsync(firstArg.Trim('"'));
                return;
            }
        }

        // Step 3: Standard interactive launch — construct and display MainWindow!
        var window = new MainWindow();
        MainWindow = window;
        window.Show();
    }

    // Loads a '.stf' profile, launches its configured game and trainer, shows a friendly
    // message ONLY if something went wrong (e.g., moved game file), and exits cleanly.
    private async Task LaunchProfileDirectlyAndShutdownAsync(string rawPath)
    {
        var cleanPath = rawPath.Trim().Trim('"');
        var service = new StoreTrainerService();
        var loadResult = service.LoadStoreFile(cleanPath);

        if (!loadResult.Success || loadResult.Profile is null)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                loadResult.ErrorMessage,
                "RaggieSoft StoreTrainer",
                MessageBoxButton.OK,
                MessageBoxImage.Warning);
            Shutdown(1);
            return;
        }

        var launchResult = await service.LaunchProfileAsync(loadResult.Profile, confirmFingerprintMismatch: prompt =>
        {
            var answer = MessageBox.Show(
                prompt,
                "Trainer File Changed — RaggieSoft StoreTrainer",
                MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
                MessageBoxImage.Warning,
                MessageBoxResult.No);
            return answer == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
        });

        if (!launchResult.Success)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(
                launchResult.Message,
                "RaggieSoft StoreTrainer",
                MessageBoxButton.OK,
                MessageBoxImage.Warning);
            Shutdown(launchResult.ErrorCode);
            return;
        }

        Shutdown(0);
    }

    // Parses 'raggiesoft-storetrainer://' deep links into either an edit target or immediate launch target.
    private static void HandleCustomProtocolUri(string rawUri, out string? launchImmediatelyPath)
    {
        launchImmediatelyPath = null;
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(rawUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
        {
            return;
        }

        // Parse simple '?file=...' query parameter without external NuGet packages.
        var query = uri.Query.TrimStart('?');
        foreach (var pair in query.Split('&', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
        {
            var kv = pair.Split('=', 2);
            if (kv.Length == 2 && string.Equals(kv[0], "file", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                var decodedPath = Uri.UnescapeDataString(kv[1]).Trim('"');
                if (string.Equals(uri.Host, "launch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    launchImmediatelyPath = decodedPath;
                }
                else
                {
                    StartupEditProfilePath = decodedPath;
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    // Releases the OS Mutex cleanly when StoreTrainer exits.
    protected override void OnExit(ExitEventArgs e)
    {
        _instanceMutex?.Dispose();
        _instanceMutex = null;
        base.OnExit(e);
    }
}

vb6-v1.1/TStore.bas (StoreTrainer 1.1 — Completed CLI Parser & Win95 Mutex)

[Classic v1.1 (Retro)]

Updated Visual Basic 6.0 startup module completing /l and /e command-line parsing and Explorer .stf double-click launches back to Windows 95.

Attribute VB_Name = "TStoreMod"
Option Explicit

' ==============================================================================
' FILE: TStore.bas (Module Name: TStoreMod)
' PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.1 (Classic Visual Basic 6.0 Edition)
' TARGET OS: Windows 95, 98, ME, NT 4.0 SP3+, 2000 SP4, XP, Vista, 7, 8.1, 10, 11
' LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation)
'
' PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
'   What is this file?
'     In Visual Basic 6.0 (VB6), 'TStore.vbp' sets 'Startup="Sub Main"', meaning
'     Windows runs 'Sub Main()' inside this module BEFORE opening any window!
'
'   What did StoreTrainer v1.1 upgrade here compared to v1.0?
'     1. Named Win32 Mutex ('RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex'):
'        Calls 'CreateMutexA' in 'kernel32.dll' (with zero backslash prefixes so
'        it works all the way back to Windows 95!). Both our NSIS v1.1 patcher
'        AND StoreTrainer 2.0's Inno Setup installer check this exact Mutex name
'        to detect if 'TStore.exe' is currently running during an upgrade.
'     2. Completed 'CheckCommandLine()' Parser:
'        - '/l "C:\...\Game.stf"': Loads the '.stf' profile, launches the game +
'          trainer immediately, and exits via 'ExitProcess' without flashing the
'          editor window on screen!
'        - '/e "C:\...\Game.stf"': Opens 'frmMain' pre-loaded with that '.stf'.
'        - '"C:\...\Game.stf"' (double-clicked in Windows Explorer): Launches!
' ==============================================================================

' Enables Windows XP+ themed Common Controls when paired with TStore.exe.manifest
Public Declare Function InitCommonControls Lib "comctl32.dll" () As Long

' Cleanly terminates the Win32 process with an integer exit code (preferable to VB6 'End')
Public Declare Sub ExitProcess Lib "kernel32" (ByVal uExitCode As Long)

' Creates a named kernel Mutex object across Windows 95 through Windows 11
Public Declare Function CreateMutexA Lib "kernel32" ( _
    ByVal lpMutexAttributes As Long, _
    ByVal bInitialOwner As Long, _
    ByVal lpName As String) As Long

' Closes a Win32 kernel handle cleanly when shutting down
Public Declare Function CloseHandle Lib "kernel32" (ByVal hObject As Long) As Long

' Module-level handle keeping 'RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex' alive while TStore.exe runs
Private g_hAppMutex As Long

' Shared path populated when '/e "file.stf"' is passed on the command line
Public g_strPendingEditFile As String

Sub Main()
    ' Step 1: Register our named Win32 Mutex so NSIS & Inno Setup installers know we are open
    g_hAppMutex = CreateMutexA(0&, 0&, "RaggieSoft_StoreTrainer_Mutex")

    ' Step 2: Turn on Windows XP+ Visual Styles before any form/dialog loads
    InitCommonControls

    ' Step 3: Ensure %APPDATA%\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini exists
    If GetStoreTrainerDataFile = "" Then
        CreateStoreTrainerData
    End If

    ' Step 4: Inspect Command$ for '/l', '/e', or a double-clicked '.stf' StoreFile!
    Dim intCmdReturn As Integer
    intCmdReturn = CheckCommandLine(Command$)

    ' Return code 2 means '/l' (or Explorer double-click) already launched the StoreFile:
    ' close our Mutex handle and exit cleanly without opening frmMain!
    If intCmdReturn = 2 Then
        ReleaseAppMutex
        ExitProcess 0
    ElseIf intCmdReturn < 0 Then
        ' Negative return indicates a command-line launch error already reported to the user
        ReleaseAppMutex
        ExitProcess Abs(intCmdReturn)
    End If

    ' Step 5: Refresh stored App.Path inside TStore.ini if TStore.exe moved folders
    Dim strCurPath As String
    strCurPath = IniGetValueString(GetStoreTrainerDataFile, "General", "Path", "PATH_NAME")
    If strCurPath <> App.Path Then
        IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataFile, "General", "Path", App.Path
    End If
    IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataFile, "General", "Version", App.Major & "." & App.Minor & "." & App.Revision

    ' Step 6: Ensure 'My Documents\My StoreFiles' exists
    Dim strSTFFolder As String
    strSTFFolder = GetStoreFileFolder(True, True)
    If (strSTFFolder = "NO_FOLDER_CREATED") Then
        MsgBox App.ProductName & " requires that you create a StoreFile folder. Now exiting!", vbCritical, App.ProductName
        ReleaseAppMutex
        ExitProcess 1
    End If

    ' Step 7: Show the main StoreFile Editor window (and load g_strPendingEditFile if '/e' was used)
    frmMain.Show
    If g_strPendingEditFile <> "" Then
        frmMain.LoadStoreFileIntoForm g_strPendingEditFile
    End If
End Sub

' Releases the Win32 Mutex handle before process exit
Public Sub ReleaseAppMutex()
    If g_hAppMutex <> 0& Then
        CloseHandle g_hAppMutex
        g_hAppMutex = 0&
    End If
End Sub

' ==============================================================================
' CheckCommandLine:
'   Parses VB6's raw Command$ string.
'   Returns:
'      0 = No command-line switch; open normal blank editor
'      1 = '/e <file.stf>' -> open editor with <file.stf> loaded
'      2 = '/l <file.stf>' (or bare '<file.stf>') -> launched immediately!
'     <0 = Error code (file missing or launch failed)
' ==============================================================================
Public Function CheckCommandLine(Optional ByVal CommandLine As String = "") As Integer
    Dim strTrimmed As String
    Dim strSwitch As String
    Dim strTargetFile As String
    Dim iOpenRet As Integer
    Dim iLaunchRet As Integer

    g_strPendingEditFile = ""
    strTrimmed = Trim$(CommandLine)
    If strTrimmed = "" Then
        CheckCommandLine = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Check if the command line starts with '/l', '-l', '/e', or '-e'
    If Len(strTrimmed) >= 3 And (Left$(strTrimmed, 1) = "/" Or Left$(strTrimmed, 1) = "-") Then
        strSwitch = LCase$(Left$(strTrimmed, 2))
        strTargetFile = StripSurroundingQuotes(Trim$(Mid$(strTrimmed, 3)))
    Else
        ' Bare file path (e.g., double-clicking 'Doom.stf' in Windows Explorer) -> treat as '/l'
        strSwitch = "/l"
        strTargetFile = StripSurroundingQuotes(strTrimmed)
    End If

    If strTargetFile = "" Then
        CheckCommandLine = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Edit Mode ('/e' or '-e')
    If strSwitch = "/e" Or strSwitch = "-e" Then
        g_strPendingEditFile = strTargetFile
        CheckCommandLine = 1
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Launch Mode ('/l' or '-l')
    If strSwitch = "/l" Or strSwitch = "-l" Then
        SetLaunchingSTF True
        iOpenRet = OpenStoreFile(strTargetFile)
        If iOpenRet <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "Unable to open StoreFile (" & strTargetFile & "). Error code: " & iOpenRet, vbExclamation, App.ProductName
            CheckCommandLine = -2
            Exit Function
        End If

        SetFileName strTargetFile
        isSilentDirtyReset
        AddRecentStoreFile strTargetFile

        iLaunchRet = Launch()
        If iLaunchRet <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "StoreTrainer could not launch the game or trainer (Code " & iLaunchRet & "). Please edit the StoreFile to check its file paths.", vbExclamation, App.ProductName
            CheckCommandLine = -3
            Exit Function
        End If

        CheckCommandLine = 2
        Exit Function
    End If

    CheckCommandLine = 0
End Function

' Helper stripping outer double-quotes from a Windows command-line path argument
Private Function StripSurroundingQuotes(ByVal sValue As String) As String
    Dim sWork As String
    sWork = Trim$(sValue)
    If Len(sWork) >= 2 Then
        If Left$(sWork, 1) = Chr$(34) And Right$(sWork, 1) = Chr$(34) Then
            sWork = Mid$(sWork, 2, Len(sWork) - 2)
        End If
    End If
    StripSurroundingQuotes = sWork
End Function

'Displays About & Legal Notice dialog (MIT Code License + Fictitious Entities Notice)
Public Sub AboutStoreTrainer()
    Dim sMsg As String
    sMsg = App.ProductName & " v" & App.Major & "." & App.Minor & "." & App.Revision & _
           " (Classic Retro Edition — Windows 95 through Windows 11)" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Copyright (C) 2018-2026 Michael P. Ragsdale (RaggieSoft)" & vbCrLf & _
           "Code License: MIT License | Website: https://storetrainer.raggiesoft.com" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "Work of Fiction Notice: While RaggieSoft StoreTrainer is a real desktop utility, " & _
           "all narrative characters, bands, universities (CPI, VDU), corporations, transit agencies, " & _
           "and LLC/Trust entities across RaggieSoft creative properties are works of fiction."
    MsgBox sMsg, vbInformation + vbOKOnly, "About " & App.ProductName
End Sub

' Creates %APPDATA%\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini on first launch
Public Sub CreateStoreTrainerData()
    Dim FSO As FileSystemObject
    Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    If Not FSO.FolderExists(FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft") Then
        MkDir FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft"
    End If
    If Not FSO.FolderExists(FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer") Then
        MkDir FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer"
    End If

    IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataDir & "\TStore.ini", "General", "Version", App.Major & "." & App.Minor & "." & App.Revision
    IniWriteValueString GetStoreTrainerDataDir & "\TStore.ini", "General", "Path", App.Path
End Sub

Public Function GetStoreTrainerDataDir() As String
    GetStoreTrainerDataDir = FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer"
End Function

Public Function GetStoreTrainerDataFile() As String
    If DoesFileExist(FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini") Then
        GetStoreTrainerDataFile = FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_APPDATA) & "\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini"
    Else
        GetStoreTrainerDataFile = ""
    End If
End Function

vb6-v1.1/SFile.bas (StoreTrainer 1.1 — Parent Folder Working Dir, Launch Delay & Recent Files)

[Classic v1.1 (Retro)]

Fixes parent-folder working directory resolution and multi-flag launch switches while adding 0–30s launch delays and Recent StoreFiles.

Attribute VB_Name = "SFile"
Option Explicit

' ==============================================================================
' FILE: SFile.bas
' PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.1 (Classic Visual Basic 6.0 Edition)
' LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation)
'
' PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
'   What is this file?
'     'SFile.bas' manages reading, writing, and launching '.stf' StoreFiles!
'     Each '.stf' file is a human-readable Windows INI file storing the path
'     and command-line switches for a PC game and its companion trainer.
'
'   Key Bug Fixes & Features Added in StoreTrainer v1.1:
'     1. Backward-Compatible Version Check ('OpenStoreFile'):
'        v1.0 rejected any '.stf' file whose version was less than the current
'        version ('iSTFCompare = -1'). v1.1 accepts BOTH '1.0' and '1.1' '.stf'
'        files seamlessly (and also interoperates with StoreTrainer 2.0!).
'     2. Working Directory Fix ('ChDir FSO.GetParentFolderName(...)'):
'        In v1.0, 'ChDir GetGamePath()' passed a '.exe' file path instead of its
'        parent folder, raising VB6 Run-time error 76 ('Path not found'). v1.1
'        extracts 'FSO.GetParentFolderName(...)' first so classic games find
'        their data WADs/PK3s/DLLs reliably.
'     3. Multi-Flag Command-Line Switch Fix:
'        In v1.0, switches were wrapped inside extra Chr$(34) quotes, turning
'        '-windowed -novid' into a single literal argument. v1.1 appends switches
'        cleanly without outer quotes.
'     4. Configurable Launch Delay ('LaunchDelaySeconds', 0–30s) & Recent Files MRU:
'        Adds '[General] LaunchDelay' using Win32 'Sleep' in 100ms slices with
'        'DoEvents' so Windows 95/98/2000 stays responsive, plus '[Recent] File1..4'.
' ==============================================================================

' Win32 Sleep API (pauses execution in milliseconds without 100% CPU busy-waiting)
Private Declare Sub Sleep Lib "kernel32" (ByVal dwMilliseconds As Long)

' In-memory state of the currently loaded StoreFile
Private isFileDirty As Boolean
Private strFileName As String
Private TrainerLaunchesGame As Boolean
Private LaunchGameFirst As Boolean
Private LaunchDelaySeconds As Long
Private GamePath As String, GameSwitch As String
Private TrainerPath As String, TrainerSwitch As String
Private doLaunch As Boolean ' Fast-exit flag during '/l' silent StoreFile launches

Public Function GetLaunchingSTF() As Boolean
    GetLaunchingSTF = doLaunch
End Function

Public Sub SetLaunchingSTF(boolDoLaunch As Boolean)
    doLaunch = boolDoLaunch
End Sub

' Clears dirty flag without touching frmMain (used by Sub Main during '/l' silent launch)
Public Sub isSilentDirtyReset()
    isFileDirty = False
End Sub

' Returns the current '.stf' schema version ('1.1' — 100% compatible with v1.0 & v2.0)
Public Function GetSTFVersionStr() As String
    GetSTFVersionStr = "1.1"
End Function

' Resets memory state for File -> New
Public Sub NewStoreFile()
    SetLaunchGameFirst False
    SetTrainerLaunchesGame False
    SetLaunchDelaySeconds 0
    SetGamePath ""
    SetGameSwitch ""
    SetTrainerPath ""
    SetTrainerSwitch ""
    SetFileName "untitled"
End Sub

Public Function GetLaunchGameFirst() As Boolean
    GetLaunchGameFirst = LaunchGameFirst
End Function

Public Sub SetLaunchGameFirst(boolLaunchGameFirst As Boolean)
    LaunchGameFirst = boolLaunchGameFirst
End Sub

Public Sub SetTrainerLaunchesGame(boolLaunchType As Boolean)
    TrainerLaunchesGame = boolLaunchType
    If boolLaunchType = True Then
        LaunchGameFirst = False
    End If
End Sub

Public Function GetTrainerLaunchesGame() As Boolean
    GetTrainerLaunchesGame = TrainerLaunchesGame
End Function

Public Function GetLaunchDelaySeconds() As Long
    GetLaunchDelaySeconds = LaunchDelaySeconds
End Function

Public Sub SetLaunchDelaySeconds(ByVal lngSeconds As Long)
    If lngSeconds < 0 Then lngSeconds = 0
    If lngSeconds > 30 Then lngSeconds = 30
    LaunchDelaySeconds = lngSeconds
End Sub

Public Function GetGamePath() As String
    GetGamePath = GamePath
End Function

Public Sub SetGamePath(strGamePath As String)
    GamePath = strGamePath
End Sub

Public Function GetTrainerPath() As String
    GetTrainerPath = TrainerPath
End Function

Public Sub SetTrainerPath(strTrainerPath As String)
    TrainerPath = strTrainerPath
End Sub

Public Function GetGameSwitch() As String
    GetGameSwitch = GameSwitch
End Function

Public Sub SetGameSwitch(strGameSwitch As String)
    GameSwitch = strGameSwitch
End Sub

Public Function GetTrainerSwitch() As String
    GetTrainerSwitch = TrainerSwitch
End Function

Public Sub SetTrainerSwitch(strTrainerSwitch As String)
    TrainerSwitch = strTrainerSwitch
End Sub

' Updates window title bar ('*' indicates unsaved edits)
Public Sub SetFileFlag(dirtyFlag As Boolean, frmName As Form)
    On Error GoTo ErrorTrap
    If dirtyFlag = True Then
        isFileDirty = True
        frmName.Caption = GetFileName(True) & " * - " & App.ProductName
    Else
        isFileDirty = False
        frmName.Caption = GetFileName(True) & " - " & App.ProductName
    End If
    Exit Sub
ErrorTrap:
    MsgBox Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, App.ProductName
End Sub

Public Function GetFileFlag() As Boolean
    GetFileFlag = isFileDirty
End Function

' Writes the current StoreFile to disk in backward-compatible INI format
Public Function SaveStoreFile(frmName As Form, strTargetFile As String) As Integer
    On Error GoTo ErrorTrapper

    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "General", "STF.Version", GetSTFVersionStr
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "General", "LaunchDelay", CStr(GetLaunchDelaySeconds())

    Dim strTrainerLaunchesGame As String
    strTrainerLaunchesGame = IIf(GetTrainerLaunchesGame(), "true", "false")
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Trainer", "TrainerLaunchesGame", strTrainerLaunchesGame

    Dim strLaunchGameFirst As String
    strLaunchGameFirst = IIf(GetLaunchGameFirst() And Not GetTrainerLaunchesGame(), "true", "false")
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Game", "LaunchGameFirst", strLaunchGameFirst

    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Game", "Path", GetGamePath
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Game", "Switch", GetGameSwitch

    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Trainer", "Path", GetTrainerPath
    IniWriteValueString strTargetFile, "Trainer", "Switch", GetTrainerSwitch

    AddRecentStoreFile strTargetFile
    SetFileFlag False, frmName
    SaveStoreFile = 0
    Exit Function

ErrorTrapper:
    SaveStoreFile = Err.Number
End Function

' Opens a '.stf' StoreFile into memory (supports both v1.0 and v1.1 '.stf' files!)
Public Function OpenStoreFile(strFilePath As String) As Integer
    Dim FSO As FileSystemObject
    Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

    If Not FSO.FileExists(strFilePath) Then
        OpenStoreFile = 53 ' VB6 File Not Found
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim strSTFVersion As String
    strSTFVersion = IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "General", "STF.Version", "1.0")

    ' Reject ONLY if the file requires a major version newer than '1.1' (e.g., '3.0').
    ' Older '1.0' files (iSTFCompare = -1) load with 100% backward compatibility!
    Dim iSTFCompare As Integer
    iSTFCompare = CheckVersion(strSTFVersion, GetSTFVersionStr)
    If iSTFCompare = 1 Then
        OpenStoreFile = 1
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim strTrainerLaunchesGame As String
    strTrainerLaunchesGame = LCase$(IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Trainer", "TrainerLaunchesGame", "false"))
    SetTrainerLaunchesGame (strTrainerLaunchesGame = "true" Or strTrainerLaunchesGame = "1")

    Dim strLaunchGameFirst As String
    strLaunchGameFirst = LCase$(IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Game", "LaunchGameFirst", "false"))
    If GetTrainerLaunchesGame() Then
        SetLaunchGameFirst False
    Else
        SetLaunchGameFirst (strLaunchGameFirst = "true" Or strLaunchGameFirst = "1")
    End If

    SetLaunchDelaySeconds CLng(Val(IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "General", "LaunchDelay", "0")))

    SetGamePath IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Game", "Path", vbNullString)
    SetGameSwitch IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Game", "Switch", vbNullString)

    SetTrainerPath IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Trainer", "Path", vbNullString)
    SetTrainerSwitch IniGetValueString(strFilePath, "Trainer", "Switch", vbNullString)

    OpenStoreFile = 0
End Function

Public Sub SetFileName(strLocalFileName As String)
    strFileName = strLocalFileName
End Sub

Public Function GetFileName(Optional showFileNameOnly As Boolean) As String
    On Error GoTo cantReadRegistry
    Dim strLocalFileName As String
    strLocalFileName = strFileName
    Dim boolHideExtensions As Boolean

    If showFileNameOnly = True Then
        Dim FSO As FileSystemObject
        Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
        boolHideExtensions = CBool(Val(RegGetValue$(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced", "HideFileExt")))
        If boolHideExtensions Then
            strLocalFileName = FSO.GetBaseName(strLocalFileName)
        Else
            strLocalFileName = FSO.GetFileName(strLocalFileName)
        End If
        GetFileName = strLocalFileName
        Exit Function
    End If

    GetFileName = strFileName
    Exit Function
cantReadRegistry:
    boolHideExtensions = False
    Resume Next
End Function

' ==============================================================================
' RECENT FILES (MRU) HELPERS — Stored in %APPDATA%\RaggieSoft\StoreTrainer\TStore.ini
' ==============================================================================
Public Sub AddRecentStoreFile(ByVal sPath As String)
    Dim sIni As String
    Dim arrExisting(1 To 4) As String
    Dim arrUpdated(1 To 4) As String
    Dim i As Integer, outIdx As Integer

    sIni = GetStoreTrainerDataFile()
    If sIni = "" Or Trim$(sPath) = "" Or LCase$(Trim$(sPath)) = "untitled" Then Exit Sub

    For i = 1 To 4
        arrExisting(i) = IniGetValueString(sIni, "Recent", "File" & CStr(i), "")
    Next i

    arrUpdated(1) = sPath
    outIdx = 2
    For i = 1 To 4
        If outIdx <= 4 Then
            If arrExisting(i) <> "" And LCase$(arrExisting(i)) <> LCase$(sPath) Then
                arrUpdated(outIdx) = arrExisting(i)
                outIdx = outIdx + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    For i = 1 To 4
        IniWriteValueString sIni, "Recent", "File" & CStr(i), arrUpdated(i)
    Next i
End Sub

Public Function GetRecentStoreFile(ByVal indexOneToFour As Integer) As String
    Dim sIni As String
    sIni = GetStoreTrainerDataFile()
    If sIni = "" Or indexOneToFour < 1 Or indexOneToFour > 4 Then
        GetRecentStoreFile = ""
        Exit Function
    End If
    GetRecentStoreFile = IniGetValueString(sIni, "Recent", "File" & CStr(indexOneToFour), "")
End Function

' Pauses between launching the first and second program while pumping Win32 events
Private Sub ResponsiveDelaySeconds(ByVal lngSeconds As Long)
    Dim totalLoops As Long, k As Long
    If lngSeconds <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    totalLoops = lngSeconds * 10
    For k = 1 To totalLoops
        Sleep 100
        DoEvents
    Next k
End Sub

' Safely changes drive + working directory to the parent folder of an executable
Private Sub SetWorkingFolderForExe(ByVal sExePath As String, ByRef FSO As FileSystemObject)
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim sParent As String
    sParent = FSO.GetParentFolderName(sExePath)
    If sParent <> "" Then
        ChDrive sParent
        ChDir sParent
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Launches the configured Game and Trainer programs
Public Function Launch() As Integer
    On Error GoTo LaunchError
    Dim FSO As FileSystemObject
    Set FSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

    ' 1. File must be saved first
    If GetFileFlag = True Or LCase$(GetFileName) = "untitled" Then
        Launch = 1
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 2. Verify Trainer executable exists
    If DoesFileExist(GetTrainerPath) = False Then
        Launch = 2
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 3. Verify Game executable exists (unless the Trainer itself launches the Game)
    If GetTrainerLaunchesGame = False Then
        If DoesFileExist(GetGamePath) = False Then
            Launch = 3
            Exit Function
        End If
    End If

    ' 4. Build command lines: quote the executable path ONLY, and append switches unquoted
    '    so multi-flag switches like '-windowed -novid' parse as separate arguments!
    Dim strGameAndSwitch As String, strTrainerAndSwitch As String
    strGameAndSwitch = Chr$(34) & GetGamePath & Chr$(34)
    If Trim$(GetGameSwitch) <> "" Then
        strGameAndSwitch = strGameAndSwitch & " " & Trim$(GetGameSwitch)
    End If

    strTrainerAndSwitch = Chr$(34) & GetTrainerPath & Chr$(34)
    If Trim$(GetTrainerSwitch) <> "" Then
        strTrainerAndSwitch = strTrainerAndSwitch & " " & Trim$(GetTrainerSwitch)
    End If

    ' Mode A: Trainer launches the game automatically -> launch Trainer only
    If GetTrainerLaunchesGame = True Then
        SetWorkingFolderForExe GetTrainerPath(), FSO
        Shell strTrainerAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
        Launch = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Mode B: Launch Game First -> optional delay -> launch Trainer
    If GetLaunchGameFirst = True Then
        SetWorkingFolderForExe GetGamePath(), FSO
        Shell strGameAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
        DoEvents
        ResponsiveDelaySeconds GetLaunchDelaySeconds()
        SetWorkingFolderForExe GetTrainerPath(), FSO
        Shell strTrainerAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
        DoEvents
        Launch = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Mode C: Launch Trainer first -> optional delay -> launch Game
    SetWorkingFolderForExe GetTrainerPath(), FSO
    Shell strTrainerAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
    DoEvents
    ResponsiveDelaySeconds GetLaunchDelaySeconds()
    SetWorkingFolderForExe GetGamePath(), FSO
    Shell strGameAndSwitch, vbNormalFocus
    DoEvents
    Launch = 0
    Exit Function

LaunchError:
    Launch = 4
End Function

vb6-v1.1/frmMain.frm (StoreTrainer 1.1 — Mutually Exclusive Launch Modes & Recent Menu)

[Classic v1.1 (Retro)]

Updated Visual Basic 6.0 main form enforcing mutually-exclusive launch checkboxes and adding the File -> Recent StoreFiles menu.

VERSION 5.00
Object = "{F9043C88-F6F2-101A-A3C9-08002B2F49FB}#1.2#0"; "comdlg32.ocx"
Begin VB.Form frmMain 
   BorderStyle     =   1  'Fixed Single

Attribute VB_Name = "frmMain"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = False
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Explicit

' ==============================================================================
' FILE: frmMain.frm
' PROJECT: RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.1 (Classic Visual Basic 6.0 Edition)
' LICENSE: MIT License (Code) / CC BY-SA 4.0 (Documentation)
'
' PLAIN-ENGLISH OVERVIEW (FOR A 100-LEVEL BEGINNER):
'   What is this file?
'     In Visual Basic 6.0, a '.frm' file combines two sections in plain text:
'       1. Lines 1–247: The visual window layout (measured in VB6 'Twips', where
'          15 Twips = 1 standard 96-DPI pixel; notice the 'picXPShim' PictureBoxes
'          inside each Frame — a classic VB6 trick preventing black radio/checkbox
'          artifacts when Windows XP Visual Styles are enabled!).
'       2. Everything below 'Option Explicit': The event-driven VB6 code-behind.
'
'   Upgrades & Bug Fixes in StoreTrainer v1.1:
'     - Enforces mutual exclusivity between 'Trainer Launches Game' and 'Launch
'       Game First' (fulfilling the 2018 developer roadmap note in README-dev.txt).
'     - Adds 'Delay (0-30s)' ('txtLaunchDelay') and 'File -> Recent' MRU items.
'     - Fixes 'mnuFileSave_Click' ('If LCase$(strFileName) = "untitled"') and
'       cancels cleanly if the user cancels the Save As dialog.
'     - Fixes 'validateFile' to report 'txt.Text' (instead of 'txtGamePath.Text')
'       and aligns Launch error codes 2 (missing trainer) & 3 (missing game).
' ==============================================================================

Private m_bPopulatingForm As Boolean

Private Sub Form_Load()
    SetFileName "untitled"
    SetFileFlag False, Me
    RefreshRecentFilesMenu
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Unload(Cancel As Integer)
    ReleaseAppMutex
End Sub

Private Sub Form_QueryUnload(Cancel As Integer, UnloadMode As Integer)
    Dim iMSG As VbMsgBoxResult

    If GetLaunchingSTF = True Then
        Cancel = False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If GetFileFlag() = False Then
        iMSG = MsgBox("Are you sure you want to exit " & App.Title & "?", vbQuestion + vbYesNo, App.ProductName)
        Cancel = (iMSG = vbNo)
    Else
        iMSG = MsgBox("Would you like to save your work before exiting?", vbQuestion + vbYesNoCancel, App.ProductName)
        If iMSG = vbYes Then
            If LCase$(GetFileName()) = "untitled" Then
                Dim strSaveFile As String
                strSaveFile = DisplaySaveAs()
                If strSaveFile = "32755" Then
                    Cancel = True
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                SetFileName strSaveFile
            End If
            SaveStoreFile Me, GetFileName()
            Cancel = False
        ElseIf iMSG = vbNo Then
            Cancel = False
        Else
            Cancel = True
        End If
    End If
End Sub

' Public helper called by File -> Open, File -> Recent, and Sub Main ('/e' switch)
Public Sub LoadStoreFileIntoForm(ByVal strPath As String)
    Dim iRet As Integer
    iRet = OpenStoreFile(strPath)
    If iRet = 53 Then
        MsgBox "The StoreFile could not be found:" & vbCrLf & strPath, vbExclamation, App.ProductName
        Exit Sub
    ElseIf iRet = 1 Then
        MsgBox "This StoreFile requires a newer version of " & App.ProductName & ".", vbExclamation, App.ProductName
        Exit Sub
    ElseIf iRet <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "Unable to open StoreFile (Code " & iRet & ").", vbExclamation, App.ProductName
        Exit Sub
    End If

    m_bPopulatingForm = True
    Me.chkTrainerLaunchesGame.Value = IIf(GetTrainerLaunchesGame(), vbChecked, vbUnchecked)
    Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Value = IIf(GetLaunchGameFirst() And Not GetTrainerLaunchesGame(), vbChecked, vbUnchecked)
    Me.txtLaunchDelay.Text = CStr(GetLaunchDelaySeconds())
    Me.txtGamePath.Text = GetGamePath()
    Me.txtGameSwitch.Text = GetGameSwitch()
    Me.txtTrainerPath.Text = GetTrainerPath()
    Me.txtTrainerSwitch.Text = GetTrainerSwitch()
    ApplyTrainerLaunchesGameUIState
    m_bPopulatingForm = False

    SetFileName strPath
    AddRecentStoreFile strPath
    RefreshRecentFilesMenu
    SetFileFlag False, Me
End Sub

Public Sub RefreshRecentFilesMenu()
    Dim s1 As String, s2 As String, s3 As String, s4 As String
    s1 = GetRecentStoreFile(1)
    s2 = GetRecentStoreFile(2)
    s3 = GetRecentStoreFile(3)
    s4 = GetRecentStoreFile(4)

    If s1 = "" Then
        mnuFileRecent1.Caption = "(No Recent StoreFiles)"
        mnuFileRecent1.Enabled = False
        mnuFileRecent1.Tag = ""
    Else
        mnuFileRecent1.Caption = "&1 " & s1
        mnuFileRecent1.Enabled = True
        mnuFileRecent1.Tag = s1
    End If

    SetupOptionalRecentMenu mnuFileRecent2, 2, s2
    SetupOptionalRecentMenu mnuFileRecent3, 3, s3
    SetupOptionalRecentMenu mnuFileRecent4, 4, s4
End Sub

Private Sub SetupOptionalRecentMenu(mnuItem As Menu, ByVal idx As Integer, ByVal sPath As String)
    If sPath = "" Then
        mnuItem.Visible = False
        mnuItem.Tag = ""
    Else
        mnuItem.Caption = "&" & CStr(idx) & " " & sPath
        mnuItem.Tag = sPath
        mnuItem.Visible = True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileRecent1_Click()
    OpenRecentFromTag mnuFileRecent1.Tag
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileRecent2_Click()
    OpenRecentFromTag mnuFileRecent2.Tag
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileRecent3_Click()
    OpenRecentFromTag mnuFileRecent3.Tag
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileRecent4_Click()
    OpenRecentFromTag mnuFileRecent4.Tag
End Sub

Private Sub OpenRecentFromTag(ByVal sPath As String)
    If sPath = "" Then Exit Sub
    If GetFileFlag() = True Then
        Dim iMSG As VbMsgBoxResult
        iMSG = MsgBox("Save changes to " & GetFileName(True) & " before opening another StoreFile?", vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, App.ProductName)
        If iMSG = vbCancel Then Exit Sub
        If iMSG = vbYes Then mnuFileSave_Click
    End If
    LoadStoreFileIntoForm sPath
End Sub

Private Sub chkLaunchGameFirst_Click()
    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetLaunchGameFirst (chkLaunchGameFirst.Value = vbChecked)
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub ApplyTrainerLaunchesGameUIState()
    Dim bTrainerStartsGame As Boolean
    bTrainerStartsGame = (chkTrainerLaunchesGame.Value = vbChecked)
    SetTrainerLaunchesGame bTrainerStartsGame

    If bTrainerStartsGame Then
        Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Value = vbUnchecked
        Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Enabled = False
        Me.txtLaunchDelay.Enabled = False
        Me.lblLaunchDelay.Enabled = False
        Me.txtGamePath.Enabled = False
        Me.txtGameSwitch.Enabled = False
        Me.cmdBrowseGame.Enabled = False
        Me.mnuProjectBrowseGame.Enabled = False
        Me.mnuProjrectSwitchGame.Enabled = False
        Me.picXPShim2.Enabled = False
        Me.fraGameData.Enabled = False
        Me.lblGameSwitch.Enabled = False
        Me.txtGamePath.BackColor = vbButtonFace
        Me.txtGameSwitch.BackColor = vbButtonFace
        Me.txtLaunchDelay.BackColor = vbButtonFace
    Else
        Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Enabled = True
        Me.txtLaunchDelay.Enabled = True
        Me.lblLaunchDelay.Enabled = True
        Me.txtGamePath.Enabled = True
        Me.txtGameSwitch.Enabled = True
        Me.cmdBrowseGame.Enabled = True
        Me.mnuProjectBrowseGame.Enabled = True
        Me.mnuProjrectSwitchGame.Enabled = True
        Me.picXPShim2.Enabled = True
        Me.fraGameData.Enabled = True
        Me.lblGameSwitch.Enabled = True
        Me.txtGamePath.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
        Me.txtGameSwitch.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
        Me.txtLaunchDelay.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub chkTrainerLaunchesGame_Click()
    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    ApplyTrainerLaunchesGameUIState
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub txtLaunchDelay_Change()
    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetLaunchDelaySeconds CLng(Val(txtLaunchDelay.Text))
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub cmdBrowseGame_Click()
    On Error GoTo Trap
    With Me.cdgStoreFile
        .CancelError = True
        .Filter = "Executable Files (*.exe)|*.exe|All Files (*.*)|*.*"
        .DefaultExt = "exe"
        .DialogTitle = "Locate Game"
        .Flags = cdlOFNFileMustExist
        .InitDir = Environ("ProgramFiles")
        .ShowOpen
        Me.txtGamePath.Text = .FileName
        SetGamePath .FileName
    End With
    validateFile txtGamePath
    SetFileFlag True, Me
    Exit Sub
Trap:
    Exit Sub
End Sub

Private Sub cmdBrowseTrainer_Click()
    On Error GoTo Trap
    With Me.cdgStoreFile
        .CancelError = True
        .InitDir = FGetSpecialFolder(CSIDL_DOCUMENTS)
        .Filter = "Executable Files (*.exe)|*.exe|All Files (*.*)|*.*"
        .DefaultExt = "exe"
        .DialogTitle = "Locate Trainer"
        .Flags = cdlOFNFileMustExist
        .ShowOpen
        Me.txtTrainerPath.Text = .FileName
        SetTrainerPath .FileName
    End With
    validateFile txtTrainerPath
    SetFileFlag True, Me
    Exit Sub
Trap:
    Exit Sub
End Sub

Private Sub cmdLaunch_Click()
    doLaunch
End Sub

Private Function DisplaySaveAs() As String
    On Error GoTo Trapper
    With Me.cdgStoreFile
        .CancelError = True
        .DialogTitle = "Save StoreFile"
        .Filter = "StoreFile (*.stf)|*.stf"
        .InitDir = GetStoreFileFolder()
        .DefaultExt = "stf"
        .ShowSave
        DisplaySaveAs = .FileName
    End With
    Exit Function
Trapper:
    If Err.Number = 32755 Then
        DisplaySaveAs = "32755"
    End If
End Function

Private Sub mnuFileExit_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileNew_Click()
    createNewStoreFile
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileOpen_Click()
    On Error GoTo Trapper
    With Me.cdgStoreFile
        .CancelError = True
        .DialogTitle = "Open StoreFile"
        .DefaultExt = "stf"
        .Filter = "StoreTrainer File (*.stf)|*.stf"
        .InitDir = GetStoreFileFolder()
        .Flags = cdlOFNFileMustExist
        .ShowOpen
        LoadStoreFileIntoForm .FileName
    End With
    Exit Sub
Trapper:
    Exit Sub
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileSave_Click()
    Dim strCurFile As String
    strCurFile = GetFileName()
    If LCase$(strCurFile) = "untitled" Then
        mnuFileSaveAs_Click
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim iRet As Integer
    iRet = SaveStoreFile(Me, GetFileName())
    RefreshRecentFilesMenu

    If iRet <> 0 And iRet <> 32755 Then
        MsgBox "Error saving StoreFile: " & iRet, vbExclamation, App.ProductName
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub mnuFileSaveAs_Click()
    Dim strFile As String
    strFile = DisplaySaveAs()
    If strFile = "32755" Or strFile = "" Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    SetFileName strFile
    SaveStoreFile Me, strFile
    RefreshRecentFilesMenu
End Sub

Private Sub mnuHelpAbout_Click()
    AboutStoreTrainer
End Sub

Private Sub mnuProjectBrowseGame_Click()
    cmdBrowseGame_Click
End Sub

Private Sub mnuProjectBrowseTrainer_Click()
    cmdBrowseTrainer_Click
End Sub

Private Sub mnuProjectLaunch_Click()
    doLaunch
End Sub

Private Sub mnuProjectSwitchTrainer_Click()
    On Error GoTo Done
    Dim strTrainerSwitch As String
    strTrainerSwitch = InputBox$("Please enter a trainer switch", "Input Trainer Switch", GetTrainerSwitch())
    If strTrainerSwitch <> "" Then
        txtTrainerSwitch.Text = strTrainerSwitch
        SetTrainerSwitch strTrainerSwitch
        SetFileFlag True, Me
    End If
Done:
End Sub

Private Sub mnuProjrectSwitchGame_Click()
    On Error GoTo Done
    Dim strGameSwitch As String
    strGameSwitch = InputBox$("Please enter a game switch", "Input Game Switch", GetGameSwitch())
    If strGameSwitch <> "" Then
        txtGameSwitch.Text = strGameSwitch
        SetGameSwitch strGameSwitch
        SetFileFlag True, Me
    End If
Done:
End Sub

Private Sub txtGamePath_Change()
    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetGamePath txtGamePath.Text
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub txtGamePath_LostFocus()
    validateFile txtGamePath
End Sub

Private Sub txtGameSwitch_Change()
    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetGameSwitch txtGameSwitch.Text
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub txtTrainerPath_Change()
    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetTrainerPath txtTrainerPath.Text
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub txtTrainerPath_LostFocus()
    validateFile txtTrainerPath
End Sub

Private Sub txtTrainerSwitch_Change()
    If m_bPopulatingForm Then Exit Sub
    SetTrainerSwitch txtTrainerSwitch.Text
    SetFileFlag True, Me
End Sub

Private Sub validateFile(txt As TextBox)
    If Trim$(txt.Text) = "" Then
        txt.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If DoesFileExist(txt.Text) = False Then
        txt.BackColor = vbRed
        MsgBox "The file " & Chr$(34) & txt.Text & Chr$(34) & " does not exist!", vbExclamation, App.Title
    Else
        txt.BackColor = vbWindowBackground
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub createNewStoreFile()
    Dim iMSG As VbMsgBoxResult
    If GetFileFlag = True Then
        iMSG = MsgBox("Would you like to save your work before creating a new StoreFile?", vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, App.Title)
        If iMSG = vbCancel Then Exit Sub
        If iMSG = vbYes Then mnuFileSave_Click
    Else
        iMSG = MsgBox("Close " & GetFileName(True) & " and create a new StoreFile?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, App.Title)
        If iMSG = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    End If

    m_bPopulatingForm = True
    NewStoreFile
    Me.chkTrainerLaunchesGame.Value = vbUnchecked
    Me.chkLaunchGameFirst.Value = vbUnchecked
    Me.txtLaunchDelay.Text = "0"
    Me.txtGamePath.Text = ""
    Me.txtGameSwitch.Text = ""
    Me.txtTrainerPath.Text = ""
    Me.txtTrainerSwitch.Text = ""
    ApplyTrainerLaunchesGameUIState
    m_bPopulatingForm = False
    SetFileFlag False, Me
End Sub

Private Sub doLaunch()
    Dim iLaunch As Integer
    iLaunch = Launch()
    If iLaunch <> 0 Then
        Select Case iLaunch
            Case 1
                MsgBox "Please save your StoreFile before launching!", vbExclamation, App.Title
            Case 2
                MsgBox "The trainer file path does not exist!", vbExclamation, App.Title
            Case 3
                MsgBox "The game file path does not exist!", vbExclamation, App.Title
            Case Else
                MsgBox "Unable to start the game or trainer (Error " & iLaunch & ").", vbExclamation, App.Title
        End Select
    End If
End Sub
